title: Holo4D: Holistic 4D Reconstruction as Geometric Control for Video Diffusion
title_zh: Holo4D：作为视频扩散几何控制的整体4D重建

paragraphs.en: Synthesizing a monocular video from a new camera trajectory requires preserving the observed scene geometry and motion while completing regions that become newly visible. Feed-forward 4D reconstructors recover the structure of the observed scene, whereas video diffusion models provide a generative prior for completing unseen content. We introduce Holo4D , a video reshooting framework that uses reconstructed 3D trajectories as a holistic source-view 4D scaffold. We project these trajectories into the requested views and encode their geometry and source appearance to guide a pretrained video diffusion model. Together with the source video and target cameras, the scaffold grounds generation in reconstructed observations while leaving unsupported regions to the generative prior. Experiments demonstrate the value of trajectory-based conditioning for camera control and novel-view synthesis. The framework accommodates different 4D reconstructors without retraining the video generator, allowing it to benefit from future advances in source reconstruction. More details can be found in our project page .
paragraphs.zh: 从新的相机轨迹合成单目视频，需要在保留已观测场景的几何与运动的同时，补全新变为可见的区域。 前馈式 4D 重建器能够恢复已观测场景的结构，而视频扩散模型则提供用于补全未见内容的生成先验。 我们提出 Holo4D，一个以重建的 3D 轨迹作为整体源视角 4D 脚手架的视频重摄框架。 我们将这些轨迹投影到所请求的视角中，并编码其几何与源外观，以引导预训练的视频扩散模型。 结合源视频与目标相机，该脚手架使生成过程扎根于重建的观测，同时将缺乏支持的区域交给生成先验处理。 实验证明了基于轨迹的条件控制对相机控制与新视角合成的价值。 该框架可兼容不同的 4D 重建器，而无需重新训练视频生成器，从而能够受益于源重建领域的未来进展。 更多详情请见我们的项目主页。

paragraphs.en: Rendering a monocular video from a new camera trajectory would allow us to change the viewpoint of a recorded scene without changing the events it depicts [ 1 ] . For example, a camera moving around a walking person should reveal a different view of the same motion, rather than generate a different action or alter the surrounding scene. This requires both faithful reconstruction of observed content and plausible completion of surfaces that become visible only from the new viewpoint. The task therefore goes beyond recovering the geometry of the input frames: it must turn partial observations of a dynamic scene into a coherent video along a user-specified camera path.
paragraphs.zh: 从新的相机轨迹渲染单目视频，可以让我们在不改变所记录场景所描绘事件的情况下改变其视角 [1]。 例如，围绕行走的人移动的相机应当展现出同一动作的不同视图，而不是生成不同的动作或改变周围的场景。 这既需要对观测内容的忠实重建，也需要对仅从新视角才能看到的表面进行合理的补全。 因此，该任务超出了恢复输入帧几何结构的范畴：它必须把动态场景的部分观测转化为沿用户指定相机路径的一致视频。

sents.zh: 这既需要对观测内容的忠实重建，也需要对仅从新视角才能看到的表面进行合理的补全。

sents.en: The task therefore goes beyond recovering the geometry of the input frames: it must turn partial observations of a dynamic scene into a coherent video along a user-specified camera path.
sents.zh: 因此，该任务超出了恢复输入帧几何结构的范畴：它必须把动态场景的部分观测转化为沿用户指定相机路径的一致视频。

paragraphs.en: Recent feed-forward reconstruction models provide an increasingly useful starting point. They estimate cameras, depth, and point maps directly from images and videos [ 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 ] , while 4D reconstruction systems also recover the trajectories of scene points over time [ 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ] . Together, these quantities describe the observed scene in a common spatial and temporal frame: camera motion can be separated from scene motion, and observations of a moving point can be linked across frames. However, reconstructing the observed scene does not by itself solve novel-view synthesis. Reprojecting its points into a new camera leaves holes where surfaces have never been observed [ 10 ] , and inaccurate geometry can produce distortions as the viewpoint changes [ 11 , 12 ] . The missing appearance must be inferred, rather than obtained by reprojection alone.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的前馈式重建模型提供了一个日益有用的起点。 它们可以直接从图像和视频估计相机、深度和点图 [ 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 ] ，而 4D 重建系统还能随时间恢复场景点的运动轨迹 [ 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ] 。 这些量共同在一个统一的空间和时间坐标系中描述观测到的场景：相机运动可以与场景运动分离，同一个运动点在不同帧中的观测也能相互关联。 然而，重建观测到的场景本身并不能解决新视角合成问题。 将这些点重投影到新的相机中，会在从未被观测到的表面处留下空洞 [ 10 ] ，而不准确的几何结构在视角变化时会产生形变 [ 11 , 12 ] 。 缺失的外观必须通过推断获得，而不能仅靠重投影得到。

sents.en: Recent feed-forward reconstruction models provide an increasingly useful starting point.
sents.zh: 近期的前馈式重建模型提供了一个日益有用的起点。

paragraphs.en: Video diffusion models offer the complementary ability to generate plausible appearance and motion from learned video priors [ 13 ] . Camera-controlled variants use these priors to synthesize new views, conditioned on camera embeddings or rendered source geometry [ 1 , 14 , 12 ] . Yet a realistic video need not preserve the geometry and dynamics of the particular scene being reconstructed. Combining reconstruction with generation is therefore not simply a matter of requesting a new camera pose: the generator also needs a representation of the scene that the camera is viewing. This motivates our central question: how should the geometry, appearance, and motion recovered from a source video be exposed to a video diffusion model?
paragraphs.zh: 视频扩散模型提供了互补的能力，能够从学习到的视频先验中生成合理的外观和运动 [ 13 ] 。 相机控制的变体利用这些先验来合成新视角，其条件是相机嵌入或渲染的源几何 [ 1 , 14 , 12 ] 。 然而一段逼真的视频未必保留被重建特定场景的几何与动态。 因此，将重建与生成相结合并非仅仅是请求一个新的相机位姿那么简单：生成器还需要相机所观察场景的一种表示。 这引出了我们的核心问题：从源视频中恢复的几何、外观和运动应当以何种方式暴露给视频扩散模型？

sents.zh: 视频扩散模型提供了互补的能力，能够从学习到的视频先验中生成合理的外观和运动 [ 13 ] 。

sents.en: Yet a realistic video need not preserve the geometry and dynamics of the particular scene being reconstructed.
sents.zh: 然而一段逼真的视频未必保留被重建特定场景的几何与动态。

sents.zh: 因此，将重建与生成相结合并非仅仅是请求一个新的相机位姿那么简单：生成器还需要相机所观察场景的一种表示。

sents.en: This motivates our central question: how should the geometry, appearance, and motion recovered from a source video be exposed to a video diffusion model?
sents.zh: 这引出了我们的核心问题：从源视频中恢复的几何、外观和运动应当以何种方式暴露给视频扩散模型？

paragraphs.en: An important part of this question is how the condition represents a scene over time. Lifting each frame independently with depth yields a sequence of point clouds, but does not explicitly specify which points correspond to the same moving surface in different frames. Vista4D [ 11 ] makes static scene content persistent by identifying static pixels and accumulating their observations in a common world frame. However, moving surfaces cannot be accumulated in the same way without accounting for their motion. Our starting point is that persistent 3D trajectories provide the required correspondence explicitly [ 6 , 7 , 8 ] . Specifically, a trajectory follows one scene point through time and associates its position with its observed appearance. A static point is the special case of a constant world-space trajectory, so static and moving points can use the same conditioning encoder.
paragraphs.zh: 这个问题的一个重要部分是条件如何随时间表示一个场景。 用深度对每一帧独立进行提升会得到一系列点云，但并未显式指明不同帧中的哪些点对应同一运动表面。 Vista4D [11] 通过识别静态像素并在一个统一的世界坐标系中累积其观测，使静态场景内容具有持久性。 然而，若不考虑运动表面的运动，就无法以同样的方式对其进行累积。 我们的出发点是，持久的3D轨迹能够显式地提供所需的对应关系 [6, 7, 8]。 具体而言，一条轨迹跟随一个场景点贯穿时间，并将其位置与其观测到的外观相关联。 静态点是恒定世界空间轨迹的特殊情况，因此静态点和运动点可以使用同一个条件编码器。

sents.zh: 这个问题的一个重要部分是条件如何随时间表示一个场景。

sents.zh: 我们的出发点是，持久的3D轨迹能够显式地提供所需的对应关系 [6, 7, 8]。

sents.zh: 具体而言，一条轨迹跟随一个场景点贯穿时间，并将其位置与其观测到的外观相关联。

sents.en: A static point is the special case of a constant world-space trajectory, so static and moving points can use the same conditioning encoder.

paragraphs.en: We introduce Holo4D , a video reshooting framework that converts reconstructed 3D trajectories and their source appearance into geometric features for video diffusion ( Figure 2 ). We call this scaffold holistic because it represents observed geometry, appearance, and motion jointly for static and dynamic points. Projecting these trajectories into the target cameras specifies where observed scene content should appear and how it should move. We use these projected trajectories to guide the video diffusion model, alongside source-video conditioning [ 15 ] and the requested camera trajectory [ 16 ] . The tracks guide observed content throughout denoising, while the video prior supplies plausible appearance in newly revealed regions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Holo4D，这是一种视频重摄框架，它将重建的 3D 轨迹及其源外观转换为用于视频扩散的几何特征（图 2）。 我们称这一支架为整体的，因为它联合表征了静态与动态点的观测几何、外观和运动。 将这些轨迹投影到目标相机中，可以指定观测到的场景内容应当出现的位置以及应当如何运动。 我们利用这些投影出的轨迹来引导视频扩散模型，同时结合源视频条件 [15] 和所请求的相机轨迹 [16]。 这些轨迹在整个去噪过程中引导已观测内容，而视频先验则为新显现的区域提供合理的外观。

sents.zh: 我们提出 Holo4D，这是一种视频重摄框架，它将重建的 3D 轨迹及其源外观转换为用于视频扩散的几何特征（图 2）。

sents.zh: 我们称这一支架为整体的，因为它联合表征了静态与动态点的观测几何、外观和运动。

sents.zh: 将这些轨迹投影到目标相机中，可以指定观测到的场景内容应当出现的位置以及应当如何运动。

sents.en: We use these projected trajectories to guide the video diffusion model, alongside source-video conditioning [ 15 ] and the requested camera trajectory [ 16 ] .
sents.zh: 我们利用这些投影出的轨迹来引导视频扩散模型，同时结合源视频条件 [15] 和所请求的相机轨迹 [16]。

sents.en: The tracks guide observed content throughout denoising, while the video prior supplies plausible appearance in newly revealed regions.
sents.zh: 这些轨迹在整个去噪过程中引导已观测内容，而视频先验则为新显现的区域提供合理的外观。

paragraphs.en: This conditioning design has two useful properties. First, we inject track features along the channel dimension [ 17 ] , providing geometric guidance without an additional rendered-video token stream [ 11 ] . Second, the scaffold uses explicit geometric quantities rather than reconstructor-specific features. Holo4D can therefore use any 4D reconstructor that provides the required geometry and trajectories [ 6 , 8 , 5 , 18 ] . Our experiments show that replacing the upstream reconstruction can substantially improve camera adherence without retraining the video generator.
paragraphs.zh: 这种条件设计有两个有用的特性。 首先，我们沿通道维度注入轨迹特征 [17]，在不引入额外的渲染视频 token 流的情况下提供几何引导 [11]。 其次，该框架使用显式的几何量，而非特定于重建器的特征。 因此，Holo4D 可以使用任何提供所需几何与轨迹的 4D 重建器 [6, 8, 5, 18]。 我们的实验表明，替换上游重建可以显著提升相机贴合度，而无需重新训练视频生成器。

sents.en: This conditioning design has two useful properties.
sents.zh: 这种条件设计有两个有用的特性。

sents.en: First, we inject track features along the channel dimension [ 17 ] , providing geometric guidance without an additional rendered-video token stream [ 11 ] .
sents.zh: 首先，我们沿通道维度注入轨迹特征 [17]，在不引入额外的渲染视频 token 流的情况下提供几何引导 [11]。

sents.en: Our experiments show that replacing the upstream reconstruction can substantially improve camera adherence without retraining the video generator.
sents.zh: 我们的实验表明，替换上游重建可以显著提升相机贴合度，而无需重新训练视频生成器。

paragraphs.en: In summary, our contributions are threefold: (1) a holistic geometric scaffold that represents static and dynamic scene observations through persistent 3D trajectories with source appearance; (2) a conditioning design that combines source-video context with channel-wise injection of projected 3D trajectory features to guide novel-view generation; and (3) camera-adherence and held-out-view evaluations against strong baselines, analyses of reconstructor substitutions and trajectory perturbations, and demonstrations on robot videos.
paragraphs.zh: 总结而言，我们的贡献有三点：(1) 一个整体性的几何骨架，通过带有源外观的持久 3D 轨迹来表示静态与动态场景观测；(2) 一种条件化设计，将源视频上下文与逐通道注入的投影 3D 轨迹特征相结合，以引导新视角生成；(3) 针对强基线的相机一致性与留出视角评估，对重建器替换与轨迹扰动的分析，以及在机器人视频上的演示。

paragraphs.en: Dynamic scenes can be reconstructed by fitting deformable radiance fields [ 19 , 20 , 21 , 22 ] or time-varying Gaussian representations [ 23 , 24 , 25 ] . ViDAR [ 26 ] additionally uses a personalized diffusion prior to supervise per-scene Gaussian reconstruction. We instead condition a shared video generator on reconstructed geometry, without per-scene optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 动态场景可以通过拟合可变形辐射场 [19, 20, 21, 22] 或随时间变化的高斯表示 [23, 24, 25] 来重建。 ViDAR [26] 额外使用个性化的扩散先验来监督每个场景的高斯重建。 我们则将一个共享的视频生成器以重建的几何为条件，而无需针对每个场景进行优化。

sents.en: Dynamic scenes can be reconstructed by fitting deformable radiance fields [ 19 , 20 , 21 , 22 ] or time-varying Gaussian representations [ 23 , 24 , 25 ] .
sents.zh: 动态场景可以通过拟合可变形辐射场 [19, 20, 21, 22] 或随时间变化的高斯表示 [23, 24, 25] 来重建。

sents.en: ViDAR [ 26 ] additionally uses a personalized diffusion prior to supervise per-scene Gaussian reconstruction.
sents.zh: ViDAR [26] 额外使用个性化的扩散先验来监督每个场景的高斯重建。

sents.en: We instead condition a shared video generator on reconstructed geometry, without per-scene optimization.
sents.zh: 我们则将一个共享的视频生成器以重建的几何为条件，而无需针对每个场景进行优化。

paragraphs.en: Learned models recover point maps, cameras, and depth from images [ 27 , 2 , 4 , 28 , 29 , 5 ] or accumulate observations over video [ 30 , 3 ] . Video depth and dynamic-scene estimators provide geometry from moving-camera videos [ 31 , 32 , 33 , 34 , 35 , 36 , 37 ] . Recent 4D methods estimate dynamic point maps, motion, or persistent trajectories [ 38 , 39 , 8 , 40 , 41 , 6 , 7 , 9 ] , while 4DGT [ 42 ] predicts 4D Gaussians from posed videos. We use compatible geometric outputs as a scaffold for video reshooting.

paragraphs.en: Geometry-guided rendering aggregates source-view information to synthesize novel views [ 43 , 44 , 45 , 46 ] . Ha et al. [ 46 ] also use temporal guidance and inpainting for multiview video. Our setting uses reconstructed 3D trajectories to condition video diffusion for reshooting a monocular video under large viewpoint changes.

paragraphs.en: Camera-conditioned diffusion models encode target views through poses or rays [ 47 , 48 , 49 , 50 , 51 , 52 , 53 ] , and have been adapted to video reshooting [ 1 , 54 ] . Explicit conditions instead ground generation in rendered source geometry [ 14 , 12 , 55 ] or warped observations [ 56 ] . paragraphs.en: Vista4D [ 11 ] conditions on source video and rendered point clouds with temporally persistent static pixels. LaVR [ 58 ] uses latent reconstruction states, whereas our interface is defined by explicit geometric quantities rather than reconstructor-specific hidden features. Go-with-the-Track [ 17 ] conditions generation on reference images and reference-anchored 2D tracks for compositing and motion control, and also supports camera retargeting. Edit-by-Track [ 59 ] edits camera and object motion in a video by conditioning on paired source and target 3D point tracks. For video reshooting, Holo4D encodes 3D trajectory positions, source color, validity, and target-camera depth into geometric features, alongside the synchronized source video.
paragraphs.zh: Vista4D [11] 以源视频和具有时间上持续静态像素的渲染点云为条件。 LaVR [58] 使用潜在重建状态，而我们的接口由显式的几何量定义，而非特定于重建器的隐藏特征。 Go-with-the-Track [17] 以参考图像和以参考为锚点的二维轨迹为条件进行生成，用于合成与运动控制，同时也支持相机重定向。 Edit-by-Track [59] 通过以成对的源三维点轨迹和目标三维点轨迹为条件，对视频中的相机与物体运动进行编辑。 对于视频重拍，Holo4D 将三维轨迹位置、源颜色、有效性以及目标相机深度编码为几何特征，并与同步的源视频一起使用。

sents.en: Vista4D [ 11 ] conditions on source video and rendered point clouds with temporally persistent static pixels.
sents.zh: Vista4D [11] 以源视频和具有时间上持续静态像素的渲染点云为条件。

sents.zh: Edit-by-Track [59] 通过以成对的源三维点轨迹和目标三维点轨迹为条件，对视频中的相机与物体运动进行编辑。

sents.en: For video reshooting, Holo4D encodes 3D trajectory positions, source color, validity, and target-camera depth into geometric features, alongside the synchronized source video.
sents.zh: 对于视频重拍，Holo4D 将三维轨迹位置、源颜色、有效性以及目标相机深度编码为几何特征，并与同步的源视频一起使用。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion priors also support geometry prediction, from monocular depth [ 60 , 61 ] to video geometry and motion [ 37 , 15 , 9 ] . Gen3R [ 62 ] jointly generates appearance and geometric latents. VIST3A [ 63 ] couples a video generator to a reconstruction decoder, while Plan4D [ 64 ] further generates plannable 4D worlds by stitching video generators and reconstruction decoders. Holo4D instead takes reconstructed geometry as input and generates target-view RGB.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散先验还支持几何预测，从单目深度 [ 60 , 61 ] 到视频几何与运动 [ 37 , 15 , 9 ] 。 Gen3R [ 62 ] 联合生成外观与几何潜变量。 VIST3A [ 63 ] 将视频生成器与重建解码器相耦合，而 Plan4D [ 64 ] 则通过拼接视频生成器与重建解码器进一步生成可规划的 4D 世界。 Holo4D 则以重建得到的几何作为输入，生成目标视角的 RGB。

sents.zh: 扩散先验还支持几何预测，从单目深度 [ 60 , 61 ] 到视频几何与运动 [ 37 , 15 , 9 ] 。

sents.zh: Holo4D 则以重建得到的几何作为输入，生成目标视角的 RGB。

paragraphs.en: Video-generation backbones increasingly serve robot learning, e.g., as world action models [ 65 ] ; Holo4D instead reshoots recorded robot videos from new viewpoints ( Section 4.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成主干网络日益被用于机器人学习，例如作为世界动作模型 [ 65 ]；Holo4D 则是从新视角重新拍摄已录制的机器人视频（第 4.5 节）。

paragraphs.en: Given a source video V src = ( I 0 src , … , I N − 1 src ) V^{\mathrm{src}}=(I_{0}^{\mathrm{src}},\dots,I_{N-1}^{\mathrm{src}}) and a target camera trajectory, Holo4D generates a video V tgt = ( I 0 tgt , … , I N − 1 tgt ) V^{\mathrm{tgt}}=(I_{0}^{\mathrm{tgt}},\dots,I_{N-1}^{\mathrm{tgt}}) that shows the same scene and motion from the requested cameras. Source and target frames with the same index refer to the same scene time. In Figure 2 , the top branch reconstructs persistent 3D trajectories from the source video, forming a 4D scaffold , projects them into the target cameras, and encodes them into target-aligned track features ( Section 3.1 ). The bottom branch, a pretrained video diffusion model, generates the target video from the source video, the target cameras, and these features ( Section 3.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 给定源视频 V src = ( I 0 src , … , I N − 1 src ) V^{\mathrm{src}}=(I_{0}^{\mathrm{src}},\dots,I_{N-1}^{\mathrm{src}}) 和目标相机轨迹，Holo4D 生成一个视频 V tgt = ( I 0 tgt , … , I N − 1 tgt ) V^{\mathrm{tgt}}=(I_{0}^{\mathrm{tgt}},\dots,I_{N-1}^{\mathrm{tgt}})，该视频从所请求的相机视角展示相同的场景和运动。 相同索引的源帧和目标帧对应同一场景时刻。 在图 2 中，上方分支从源视频重建持久的 3D 轨迹，形成一个 4D 脚手架，将其投影到目标相机，并编码为与目标对齐的轨迹特征（第 3.1 节）。 下方分支是一个预训练的视频扩散模型，它根据源视频、目标相机以及这些特征生成目标视频（第 3.2 节）。

sents.en: In Figure 2 , the top branch reconstructs persistent 3D trajectories from the source video, forming a 4D scaffold , projects them into the target cameras, and encodes them into target-aligned track features ( Section 3.1 ).
sents.zh: 在图 2 中，上方分支从源视频重建持久的 3D 轨迹，形成一个 4D 脚手架，将其投影到目标相机，并编码为与目标对齐的轨迹特征（第 3.1 节）。

sents.zh: 下方分支是一个预训练的视频扩散模型，它根据源视频、目标相机以及这些特征生成目标视频（第 3.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: Reshooting a dynamic scene requires specifying where observed content should appear in each target frame and how its position changes over time. A video diffusion model conditioned only on the source video and target cameras [ 1 ] must infer this layout implicitly from appearance. Without an explicit scene representation, it struggles to preserve source-scene geometry and follow the requested camera under large viewpoint changes [ 58 , 11 ] . To provide explicit geometric guidance, existing methods lift source frames into point clouds using estimated depth and render them from the target cameras [ 14 , 12 ] . However, even when static points are accumulated across frames [ 11 ] , independently reconstructed dynamic points do not explicitly establish correspondence between moving surfaces across frames. We therefore represent the source scene by persistent 3D trajectories [ 66 ] , each carrying the appearance of a source observation.
paragraphs.zh: 对动态场景进行重拍需要指定所观测到的内容应出现在每个目标帧的什么位置，以及其位置如何随时间变化。 仅以源视频和目标相机为条件的视频扩散模型 [ 1 ] 必须从外观中隐式推断这种布局。 由于缺乏显式的场景表示，模型难以在大视角变化下保持源场景的几何结构并遵循所要求的相机运动 [ 58 , 11 ] 。 为了提供显式的几何引导，现有方法利用估计的深度将源帧提升为点云，并从目标相机进行渲染 [ 14 , 12 ] 。 然而，即使将静态点跨帧累积 [ 11 ] ，独立重建的动态点也未能显式建立跨帧运动表面之间的对应关系。 因此，我们用持久的三维轨迹 [ 66 ] 来表示源场景，每条轨迹携带一次源观测的外观信息。

sents.zh: 对动态场景进行重拍需要指定所观测到的内容应出现在每个目标帧的什么位置，以及其位置如何随时间变化。

sents.zh: 为了提供显式的几何引导，现有方法利用估计的深度将源帧提升为点云，并从目标相机进行渲染 [ 14 , 12 ] 。

sents.zh: 然而，即使将静态点跨帧累积 [ 11 ] ，独立重建的动态点也未能显式建立跨帧运动表面之间的对应关系。

sents.en: We therefore represent the source scene by persistent 3D trajectories [ 66 ] , each carrying the appearance of a source observation.
sents.zh: 因此，我们用持久的三维轨迹 [ 66 ] 来表示源场景，每条轨迹携带一次源观测的外观信息。

paragraphs.en: To construct this scaffold, we use a 4D reconstructor ℛ \mathcal{R} to recover camera poses and point trajectories from the source video [ 6 , 7 , 8 , 5 , 18 ] . Each trajectory follows a scene point n n through its positions 𝐩 n , j \mathbf{p}_{n,j} at successive frames j j and carries a color 𝐜 n \mathbf{c}_{n} , sampled from the source frame q n q_{n} where the point was queried. We express these positions and the target cameras in the coordinate frame of the first source camera [ 27 , 8 ] , where static points have constant positions and moving points trace out their motion. Any reconstructor providing these trajectories and cameras can supply the scaffold.
paragraphs.zh: 为了构建这一骨架，我们使用一个4D重建器 ℛ \mathcal{R} 从源视频中恢复相机位姿和点轨迹 [ 6 , 7 , 8 , 5 , 18 ] 。 每条轨迹跟随场景点 n n 在连续帧 j j 中的位置 𝐩 n , j \mathbf{p}_{n,j} ，并携带颜色 𝐜 n \mathbf{c}_{n} ，该颜色采样自该点被查询的源帧 q n q_{n} 。 我们在第一个源相机的坐标系 [ 27 , 8 ] 中表示这些位置和目标相机，其中静态点具有恒定位置，运动点则描绘出其运动轨迹。 任何能提供这些轨迹和相机的重建器都可以提供该骨架。

sents.en: To construct this scaffold, we use a 4D reconstructor ℛ \mathcal{R} to recover camera poses and point trajectories from the source video [ 6 , 7 , 8 , 5 , 18 ] .
sents.zh: 为了构建这一骨架，我们使用一个4D重建器 ℛ \mathcal{R} 从源视频中恢复相机位姿和点轨迹 [ 6 , 7 , 8 , 5 , 18 ] 。

sents.en: Each trajectory follows a scene point n n through its positions 𝐩 n , j \mathbf{p}_{n,j} at successive frames j j and carries a color 𝐜 n \mathbf{c}_{n} , sampled from the source frame q n q_{n} where the point was queried.
sents.zh: 每条轨迹跟随场景点 n n 在连续帧 j j 中的位置 𝐩 n , j \mathbf{p}_{n,j} ，并携带颜色 𝐜 n \mathbf{c}_{n} ，该颜色采样自该点被查询的源帧 q n q_{n} 。

sents.en: We express these positions and the target cameras in the coordinate frame of the first source camera [ 27 , 8 ] , where static points have constant positions and moving points trace out their motion.
sents.zh: 我们在第一个源相机的坐标系 [ 27 , 8 ] 中表示这些位置和目标相机，其中静态点具有恒定位置，运动点则描绘出其运动轨迹。

sents.en: Any reconstructor providing these trajectories and cameras can supply the scaffold.
sents.zh: 任何能提供这些轨迹和相机的重建器都可以提供该骨架。

paragraphs.en: To express the scaffold in the target views, we project each 𝐩 n , j \mathbf{p}_{n,j} with the target intrinsics K j tgt K_{j}^{\mathrm{tgt}} and pose π j tgt \pi_{j}^{\mathrm{tgt}} of frame j j . This determines the point’s target-view pixel location and its target-camera depth d n , j d_{n,j} , both computed from the reconstructed 3D position. A validity flag v n , j v_{n,j} marks observations that are valid according to the upstream reconstructor and project inside the target image; it does not account for occlusion by other points. Each observation carries its frame index, position 𝐩 n , j \mathbf{p}_{n,j} , depth d n , j d_{n,j} , validity v n , j v_{n,j} , and color 𝐜 n \mathbf{c}_{n} . The color stays fixed along the trajectory, linking source appearance to the point’s reconstructed motion.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在目标视图中表达脚手架，我们使用帧 j j 的目标内参 K j tgt K_{j}^{\mathrm{tgt}} 和目标位姿 π j tgt \pi_{j}^{\mathrm{tgt}} 对每个 𝐩 n , j \mathbf{p}_{n,j} 进行投影。 这确定了该点的目标视图像素位置及其目标相机深度 d n , j d_{n,j}，两者均由重建的三维位置计算得到。 有效性标志 v n , j v_{n,j} 标记依据上游重建器有效且投影落在目标图像内部的观测；它不考虑被其他点遮挡的情况。 每个观测携带其帧索引、位置 𝐩 n , j \mathbf{p}_{n,j}、深度 d n , j d_{n,j}、有效性 v n , j v_{n,j} 以及颜色 𝐜 n \mathbf{c}_{n}。 颜色在轨迹上保持固定，将源外观与该点的重建运动联系起来。

sents.en: A validity flag v n , j v_{n,j} marks observations that are valid according to the upstream reconstructor and project inside the target image; it does not account for occlusion by other points.
sents.zh: 有效性标志 v n , j v_{n,j} 标记依据上游重建器有效且投影落在目标图像内部的观测；它不考虑被其他点遮挡的情况。

sents.en: Each observation carries its frame index, position 𝐩 n , j \mathbf{p}_{n,j} , depth d n , j d_{n,j} , validity v n , j v_{n,j} , and color 𝐜 n \mathbf{c}_{n} .
sents.zh: 每个观测携带其帧索引、位置 𝐩 n , j \mathbf{p}_{n,j}、深度 d n , j d_{n,j}、有效性 v n , j v_{n,j} 以及颜色 𝐜 n \mathbf{c}_{n}。

sents.en: The color stays fixed along the trajectory, linking source appearance to the point’s reconstructed motion.
sents.zh: 颜色在轨迹上保持固定，将源外观与该点的重建运动联系起来。

paragraphs.en: Finally, we convert the projected observations into a feature volume aligned with the target video. A sinusoidal encoding [ 67 ] followed by a shared MLP maps the attributes of each observation to a feature vector, which is scattered to its projected location on a target-view grid. Features of observations that fall into the same cell are combined by a channel-wise maximum, and an occupancy channel records which cells received any observation. A causal 3D convolutional adapter then brings this volume to the DiT token grid, producing the track features 𝐓 \mathbf{T} ; target tokens with no projected observations receive a learned null embedding. For a fixed target-video resolution and duration, the resulting feature volume has a size independent of the number of trajectories. Normalization, masking, and dataset-specific depth handling are given in Appendix B .
paragraphs.zh: 最后，我们将投影后的观测转换为与目标视频对齐的特征体。 正弦编码[67]后接一个共享的多层感知机，将每个观测的属性映射为特征向量，该特征向量被散射到目标视图网格上的投影位置。 落入同一单元格的观测特征通过逐通道取最大值进行合并，同时用一个占据通道记录哪些单元格接收到了观测。 随后，一个因果三维卷积适配器将该特征体转换到 DiT 词元网格上，生成轨迹特征 𝐓 \mathbf{T}；没有投影观测的目标词元则接收一个可学习的空嵌入。 对于固定的目标视频分辨率和时长，所得特征体的大小与轨迹数量无关。 归一化、掩码以及特定数据集的深度处理见附录 B。

paragraphs.en: The generator is a pretrained video diffusion transformer that combines source-video context, target-camera features, and the track features 𝐓 \mathbf{T} . The VAE encodes the source video into latents x src x^{\mathrm{src}} , concatenated with the noisy target latents x τ tgt x_{\tau}^{\mathrm{tgt}} along the width [ 15 ] . This keeps synchronized source and target frames at the same temporal index, whereas temporal concatenation [ 11 , 1 ] places them at different indices. Learned domain embeddings distinguish the source and target halves. The text prompt enters through the backbone’s pretrained cross-attention.
paragraphs.zh: 生成器是一个预训练的视频扩散 Transformer，它融合了源视频上下文、目标相机特征以及轨迹特征 𝐓 \mathbf{T} 。 VAE 将源视频编码为隐变量 x src x^{\mathrm{src}} ，并沿宽度方向与带噪的目标隐变量 x τ tgt x_{\tau}^{\mathrm{tgt}} 拼接 [ 15 ] 。 这使得源帧与目标帧在相同的时间索引上保持同步，而时间维拼接 [ 11 , 1 ] 则会将它们放在不同的索引位置。 可学习的域嵌入用于区分源视频部分和目标视频部分。 文本提示通过骨干网络的预训练交叉注意力输入。

paragraphs.en: The track features enter the transformer along the channel dimension, following Go-with-the-Track [ 17 ] , rather than as an additional sequence of tokens. We place them on the target half of the sequence and extend 𝐓 \mathbf{T} on the source half with the same learned null embedding used for unoccupied target tokens. Channel-wise injection leaves the self-attention sequence length unchanged, and our model achieves a 1.34 × 1.34\times denoising speedup over Vista4D ( Table 24 ).
paragraphs.zh: 轨迹特征沿通道维度进入 transformer（遵循 Go-with-the-Track [17] 的做法），而不是作为额外的 token 序列。 我们将它们放在序列的目标侧，并在源侧用与未占用的目标 token 相同的可学习空嵌入来扩展 𝐓 \mathbf{T}。 按通道注入使自注意力序列长度保持不变，我们的模型相比 Vista4D 实现了 1.34 × 1.34\times 的去噪加速（表 24）。

paragraphs.en: We train on a mixture of synthetic multiview videos of dynamic scenes [ 73 , 74 , 1 ] , real videos of static scenes [ 75 , 76 ] , and synthetic static-scene sequences [ 77 , 78 ] . For dynamic scenes, source–target pairs come from synchronized multiview videos. For static scenes, we form source–target pairs from different chunks of the same monocular video, similar to 4Real-Video-V2 [ 79 ] ; temporal synchronization is unnecessary since the scene is static. This mixture covers both scene motion and camera motion, with estimated or ground-truth 3D trajectory annotations; dataset names, sampling weights, and annotation sources are given in Appendix C .

paragraphs.en: We evaluate camera control and novel-view synthesis ( Sections 4.2 and 4.3 ), analyze geometric conditioning ( Section 4.4 ), and demonstrate robot-video applications ( Section 4.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估相机控制与新视角合成（第 4.2 节和第 4.3 节），分析几何条件约束（第 4.4 节），并展示机器人视频应用（第 4.5 节）。

paragraphs.en: We compare Holo4D with several representative state-of-the-art methods, including ReCamMaster [ 1 ] , TrajectoryCrafter [ 14 ] , EX-4D [ 55 ] , Gen3C [ 12 ] , and the concurrent Vista4D [ 11 ] . ReCamMaster is a camera-only baseline: it conditions on the source video and the target cameras. The others are rendered-geometry baselines: they also render source geometry from target cameras; Vista4D keeps static geometry persistent across frames.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 Holo4D 与多个具有代表性的最先进方法进行比较，包括 ReCamMaster [1]、TrajectoryCrafter [14]、EX-4D [55]、Gen3C [12] 以及同期工作 Vista4D [11]。 ReCamMaster 是一个仅依赖相机的基线：它以源视频和目标相机为条件。 其余方法是基于渲染几何的基线：它们同样从目标相机渲染源几何；Vista4D 则在各帧之间保持静态几何的持续性。

sents.en: We compare Holo4D with several representative state-of-the-art methods, including ReCamMaster [ 1 ] , TrajectoryCrafter [ 14 ] , EX-4D [ 55 ] , Gen3C [ 12 ] , and the concurrent Vista4D [ 11 ] .
sents.zh: 我们将 Holo4D 与多个具有代表性的最先进方法进行比较，包括 ReCamMaster [1]、TrajectoryCrafter [14]、EX-4D [55]、Gen3C [12] 以及同期工作 Vista4D [11]。

sents.en: ReCamMaster is a camera-only baseline: it conditions on the source video and the target cameras.
sents.zh: ReCamMaster 是一个仅依赖相机的基线：它以源视频和目标相机为条件。

sents.en: The others are rendered-geometry baselines: they also render source geometry from target cameras; Vista4D keeps static geometry persistent across frames.
sents.zh: 其余方法是基于渲染几何的基线：它们同样从目标相机渲染源几何；Vista4D 则在各帧之间保持静态几何的持续性。

paragraphs.en: For camera control, we select 50 50 DAVIS [ 80 ] clips and randomly sample two target camera trajectories per clip, and also evaluate on Vista4D’s released 110 110 -trajectory benchmark. Five iPhone/DyCheck scenes [ 81 ] provide synchronized held-out views, while held-out Syn4D [ 73 ] scenes provide exact target RGB and geometry. For each metric, all methods are evaluated at the same resolution; detailed protocols are in Appendices D , F and I .
paragraphs.zh: 在相机控制方面，我们选取 50 50 个 DAVIS [ 80 ] 片段，并从每个片段中随机采样两条目标相机轨迹，同时在 Vista4D 发布的 110 110 条轨迹基准上进行评估。 五个 iPhone/DyCheck 场景 [ 81 ] 提供了同步的保留视角，而保留的 Syn4D [ 73 ] 场景则提供了精确的目标 RGB 和几何信息。 对于每项指标，所有方法均在相同分辨率下进行评估；详细协议见附录 D 、 F 和 I 。

paragraphs.en: Our default source reconstructor ℛ \mathcal{R} is 4RC [ 6 ] . We also test two-stage 4D reconstruction from 3D geometry and 2D tracking, as used for annotation in MolmoMotion [ 82 ] , by combining VGGT- Ω \Omega [ 5 ] with CoWTracker [ 18 ] . For this two-stage backend, we optionally use GMOS [ 83 ] to hold background points fixed in 3D while preserving foreground motion.
paragraphs.zh: 我们默认的源重建器 ℛ \mathcal{R} 是 4RC [ 6 ] 。 我们还测试了从 3D 几何和 2D 跟踪进行的两阶段 4D 重建，即 MolmoMotion [ 82 ] 中用于标注的方法，通过将 VGGT- Ω \Omega [ 5 ] 与 CoWTracker [ 18 ] 相结合实现。 对于这一两阶段后端，我们可选地使用 GMOS [ 83 ] 来在保持前景运动的同时将背景点固定在 3D 空间中。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 compares camera control on 100 100 DAVIS video–trajectory pairs using VGGT- Ω \Omega camera recovery [ 5 ] . ATE measures trajectory error; RPE-T and RPE-R measure adjacent-frame translation and rotation errors. Translation metrics use 54 54 pairs; rotation uses all 100 100 . Holo4D has the lowest trajectory and translation errors of all methods and lower rotation error than all rendered-geometry baselines. With both methods using 4RC source reconstruction on DAVIS, Holo4D reduces ATE by 54 % 54\% and RPE-T by 33 % 33\% compared with the concurrent Vista4D. ReCamMaster attains a slightly lower rotation error ( 0.099 ∘ 0.099^{\circ} versus 0.102 ∘ 0.102^{\circ} ) but the largest trajectory error of all methods, consistent with outputs that stay close to the source viewpoint.
paragraphs.zh: 表 2 使用 VGGT-Ω \Omega 相机恢复 [5] 在 100 100 个 DAVIS 视频–轨迹对上比较相机控制性能。 ATE 衡量轨迹误差；RPE-T 和 RPE-R 衡量相邻帧的平移和旋转误差。 平移指标使用 54 54 个视频对；旋转指标使用全部 100 100 个视频对。 在所有方法中，Holo4D 具有最低的轨迹和平移误差，并且旋转误差低于所有基于渲染几何的基线方法。 在两种方法都在 DAVIS 上使用 4RC 源重建的情况下，与同期工作 Vista4D 相比，Holo4D 将 ATE 降低了 54 % 54\%，将 RPE-T 降低了 33 % 33\%。 ReCamMaster 取得了略低的旋转误差（0.099 ∘ 0.099^{\circ} 对 0.102 ∘ 0.102^{\circ}），但其轨迹误差在所有方法中最大，这与它的输出始终接近源视角相一致。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 reports five VBench [ 84 ] dimensions on the same DAVIS videos. Holo4D scores highest on imaging quality and, among rendered-geometry baselines, on subject and background consistency; it also exceeds Vista4D on aesthetic quality, with a marginally lower temporal-style score. ReCamMaster’s high consistency accompanies the largest trajectory error: consistency alone does not establish camera fidelity. FVD computed against source videos can reward copying the input despite failed camera control. We therefore report FVD only on Syn4D, using ground-truth target-view videos as references; Holo4D achieves the lowest FVD with ground-truth source geometry ( Table 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 表 2 报告了在相同 DAVIS 视频上的五个 VBench [84] 维度。 Holo4D 在成像质量上得分最高，并且在渲染几何基线中在主体和背景一致性上也得分最高；它在美学质量上还超过了 Vista4D，仅时间风格得分略低。 ReCamMaster 的高一致性伴随着最大的轨迹误差：仅凭一致性并不能确立相机保真度。 针对源视频计算的 FVD 可能会奖励复制输入的做法，即使相机控制失败。 因此我们仅在 Syn4D 上报告 FVD，使用真实目标视角视频作为参考；Holo4D 在使用真实源几何的情况下取得了最低的 FVD（表 3）。

paragraphs.en: Syn4D provides exact target views and source geometry, removing reconstruction error from the comparison. With ground-truth source depth and cameras for rendered-geometry baselines and 3D trajectories for Holo4D , Holo4D leads on all camera and image metrics ( Table 3 ). With 4RC estimates on a separate 32 32 -pair set, Holo4D leads on camera errors and LPIPS, while camera-only ReCamMaster leads on PSNR and SSIM ( Table 19 ). Test scenes are held out, but Syn4D is in our training mixture and the baseline checkpoints are not adapted to it; real-video evaluations test beyond our training datasets.
paragraphs.zh: Syn4D 提供精确的目标视图和源几何，从而在比较中消除了重建误差。 借助渲染几何基线的真值源深度与相机参数，以及 Holo4D 的 3D 轨迹，Holo4D 在所有相机和图像指标上均领先（表 3）。 在另一个 32 对组合上进行 4RC 估计时，Holo4D 在相机误差和 LPIPS 上领先，而仅使用相机的 ReCamMaster 在 PSNR 和 SSIM 上领先（表 19）。 测试场景均为留出数据，但 Syn4D 包含在我们的训练混合集中，而基线检查点并未针对其进行适配；真实视频评估则在我们的训练数据集之外进行测试。

paragraphs.en: We reconstruct generated-video depth and compare it with exact target depth on Syn4D ( Table 20 ). Holo4D has the lowest AbsRel and highest δ 1 \delta_{1} under both output reconstructors, VGGT- Ω \Omega and 4RC; VGGT- Ω \Omega AbsRel falls from Vista4D’s 0.628 0.628 to 0.423 0.423 . On iPhone, with reconstructed target-video depth as a pseudo-reference, our two-stage variant also has the lowest AbsRel under both reconstructors, supporting improved generated-view geometry.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对生成视频的深度进行重建，并在 Syn4D 上将其与精确的目标深度进行比较（表 20）。 在两种输出重建器 VGGT- Ω \Omega 和 4RC 下，Holo4D 都具有最低的 AbsRel 和最高的 δ 1 \delta_{1}；VGGT- Ω \Omega 的 AbsRel 从 Vista4D 的 0.628 0.628 降至 0.423 0.423。 在 iPhone 上，以重建的目标视频深度作为伪参考，我们的两阶段变体在两种重建器下同样具有最低的 AbsRel，这支持了生成视图几何的改进。

Given the same first 49 49 source frames, our two-stage variant has higher PSNR and lower LPIPS, including masked variants, while ViDAR has higher SSIM ( Table 18 ); ViDAR natively uses the full sequence.
paragraphs.zh: ViDAR [26] 在 A6000 上对每个 iPhone 场景进行优化大约需要 5 5 小时 18 18 分钟；Holo4D 则不需要针对场景的优化。 在相同的最初 49 49 帧源帧下，我们的两阶段变体具有更高的 PSNR 和更低的 LPIPS（包括掩码变体），而 ViDAR 的 SSIM 更高（表 18）；ViDAR 原生使用完整序列。

paragraphs.en: Because the track condition enters along channels, Holo4D adds no tokens to self-attention, whereas Vista4D appends a rendered-video token sequence. In a matched comparison at 384 × 672 × 49 384\times 672\times 49 with 50 50 denoising steps on one H200, Holo4D achieves a 1.34 × 1.34\times denoising speedup ( 7.39 7.39 versus 9.89 9.89 s) at similar peak memory ( Table 24 ); end-to-end time per video is nonetheless similar ( 570.9 570.9 versus 581.9 581.9 s), since loading, conditioning, decoding, and writing offset the gain. Source reconstruction is paid once per input video and reused across target trajectories ( 8.8 8.8 s for 4RC and 11.8 11.8 s for the two-stage backend in warm A6000 runs, Table 24 ); only projection and encoding are redone per trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 由于轨迹条件以通道方式进入，Holo4D 不会向自注意力添加任何 token，而 Vista4D 则会追加一段渲染视频的 token 序列。 在一台 H200 上以 384 × 672 × 49、50 步去噪的匹配对比中，Holo4D 在相近峰值显存下取得了 1.34 倍的去噪加速（7.39 秒对 9.89 秒）（表 24）；但由于加载、条件注入、解码与写盘抵消了这一收益，每个视频的端到端耗时仍然相近（570.9 秒对 581.9 秒）。 源视频重建只需对每个输入视频执行一次，并可在多条目标轨迹间复用（在预热的 A6000 运行中，4RC 为 8.8 秒，两阶段后端为 11.8 秒，表 24）；每条轨迹只需重新执行投影和编码。

sents.en: Because the track condition enters along channels, Holo4D adds no tokens to self-attention, whereas Vista4D appends a rendered-video token sequence.
sents.zh: 由于轨迹条件以通道方式进入，Holo4D 不会向自注意力添加任何 token，而 Vista4D 则会追加一段渲染视频的 token 序列。

sents.en: In a matched comparison at 384 × 672 × 49 384\times 672\times 49 with 50 50 denoising steps on one H200, Holo4D achieves a 1.34 × 1.34\times denoising speedup ( 7.39 7.39 versus 9.89 9.89 s) at similar peak memory ( Table 24 ); end-to-end time per video is nonetheless similar ( 570.9 570.9 versus 581.9 581.9 s), since loading, conditioning, decoding, and writing offset the gain.
sents.zh: 在一台 H200 上以 384 × 672 × 49、50 步去噪的匹配对比中，Holo4D 在相近峰值显存下取得了 1.34 倍的去噪加速（7.39 秒对 9.89 秒）（表 24）；但由于加载、条件注入、解码与写盘抵消了这一收益，每个视频的端到端耗时仍然相近（570.9 秒对 581.9 秒）。

sents.en: Source reconstruction is paid once per input video and reused across target trajectories ( 8.8 8.8 s for 4RC and 11.8 11.8 s for the two-stage backend in warm A6000 runs, Table 24 ); only projection and encoding are redone per trajectory.
sents.zh: 源视频重建只需对每个输入视频执行一次，并可在多条目标轨迹间复用（在预热的 A6000 运行中，4RC 为 8.8 秒，两阶段后端为 11.8 秒，表 24）；每条轨迹只需重新执行投影和编码。

Holo4D preserves the diner’s orientation, rear window, and lights while following the requested path; Tables 2 and 6 quantify camera accuracy, and Figure 16 shows two further trajectories. paragraphs.en: Conditioning design. Table 4 compares conditioning variants trained with the same stage-1 recipe ( 15 15 k steps at 144 × 256 144\times 256 ). Removing the per-track color raises ATE by 44 % 44\% even though the source video remains available, so track-attached appearance is not redundant with the video. Removing target depth has a smaller effect, likely because depth follows from the 3D positions and target cameras. Adding rendered RGB and mask features to the track features improves none of the camera metrics, favoring trajectory-only conditioning for camera control at this training budget.
paragraphs.zh: 条件化设计。 表4比较了使用相同第一阶段方案（在 144 × 256 144\times 256 分辨率下训练 15 15 k 步）训练的各条件化变体。 移除逐轨迹颜色会使 ATE 提高 44 % 44\%，即使源视频仍然可用，这说明轨迹附加的外观信息与视频并不冗余。 移除目标深度的影响较小，可能是因为深度可以由 3D 位置和目标相机推得。 在轨迹特征中加入渲染的 RGB 和掩码特征并未改善任何相机指标，因此在当前训练预算下，相机控制更适合仅使用轨迹的条件化。

sents.en: Conditioning design.
sents.zh: 条件化设计。

sents.en: Table 4 compares conditioning variants trained with the same stage-1 recipe ( 15 15 k steps at 144 × 256 144\times 256 ).
sents.zh: 表4比较了使用相同第一阶段方案（在 144 × 256 144\times 256 分辨率下训练 15 15 k 步）训练的各条件化变体。

sents.zh: 移除逐轨迹颜色会使 ATE 提高 44 % 44\%，即使源视频仍然可用，这说明轨迹附加的外观信息与视频并不冗余。

sents.en: Adding rendered RGB and mask features to the track features improves none of the camera metrics, favoring trajectory-only conditioning for camera control at this training budget.

paragraphs.en: Reconstruction backends. The same generator accepts 4RC, V-DPM, and VGGT- Ω \Omega paired with Open-D4RT or CoWTracker as ℛ \mathcal{R} without retraining ( Table 5 ), and the backends trade off differently: the CoWTracker variant gives the best ATE, PSNR, and SSIM, V-DPM the best rotation error, and 4RC the best LPIPS. Ground-truth geometry improves all five metrics, leaving room for better reconstructors.
paragraphs.zh: 重建后端。 同一生成器无需重新训练即可接受 4RC、V-DPM 和 VGGT- \Omega \Omega，并将其与 Open-D4RT 或 CoWTracker 作为 ℛ \mathcal{R} 配对（表 5），各后端的权衡表现不同：CoWTracker 变体在 ATE、PSNR 和 SSIM 上表现最佳，V-DPM 的旋转误差最小，4RC 的 LPIPS 最佳。 真值几何提升了全部五项指标，说明仍有改进重建器的空间。

sents.en: Reconstruction backends.
sents.zh: 重建后端。

sents.zh: 真值几何提升了全部五项指标，说明仍有改进重建器的空间。

paragraphs.en: Trajectory accuracy. To isolate the effect of geometric error, we add Gaussian noise to ground-truth tracks, with standard deviation α \alpha times that of the source tracks along each axis, keeping all other inputs fixed. Even mild noise ( α = 0.1 \alpha=0.1 ) triples rotation error ( 0.073 ∘ 0.073^{\circ} to 0.221 ∘ 0.221^{\circ} ) and degrades SSIM and LPIPS although the clean source video remains available, showing that clean video context does not fully compensate for geometric error. ATE does not grow beyond α = 0.1 \alpha=0.1 ; independent alignment of each recovered camera trajectory can absorb part of the error. Full results and protocols are in Appendices G and I .
paragraphs.zh: 轨迹精度。 为了隔离几何误差的影响，我们在真值轨迹上加入高斯噪声，其标准差为源轨迹在各轴上标准差的 α \alpha 倍，同时保持所有其他输入不变。 即使是轻微的噪声（ α = 0.1 \alpha=0.1 ）也会使旋转误差增至三倍（从 0.073 ∘ 0.073^{\circ} 到 0.221 ∘ 0.221^{\circ} ），并降低 SSIM 和 LPIPS，尽管干净的源视频仍然可用，这表明干净的视频上下文并不能完全弥补几何误差。 当 α = 0.1 \alpha=0.1 之后 ATE 不再增长；对每条恢复的相机轨迹进行独立对齐可以吸收部分误差。 完整结果与实验协议见附录 G 和附录 I。

sents.en: Trajectory accuracy.
sents.zh: 轨迹精度。

sents.en: Even mild noise ( α = 0.1 \alpha=0.1 ) triples rotation error ( 0.073 ∘ 0.073^{\circ} to 0.221 ∘ 0.221^{\circ} ) and degrades SSIM and LPIPS although the clean source video remains available, showing that clean video context does not fully compensate for geometric error.
sents.zh: 即使是轻微的噪声（ α = 0.1 \alpha=0.1 ）也会使旋转误差增至三倍（从 0.073 ∘ 0.073^{\circ} 到 0.221 ∘ 0.221^{\circ} ），并降低 SSIM 和 LPIPS，尽管干净的源视频仍然可用，这表明干净的视频上下文并不能完全弥补几何误差。

sents.en: ATE does not grow beyond α = 0.1 \alpha=0.1 ; independent alignment of each recovered camera trajectory can absorb part of the error.
sents.zh: 当 α = 0.1 \alpha=0.1 之后 ATE 不再增长；对每条恢复的相机轨迹进行独立对齐可以吸收部分误差。

sents.en: Full results and protocols are in Appendices G and I .
sents.zh: 完整结果与实验协议见附录 G 和附录 I。

paragraphs.en: With ground-truth source geometry on nine held-out Syn4D clips, Holo4D has lower error on all five camera metrics than Vista4D, including source-aligned rotation ( 0.242 ∘ 0.242^{\circ} versus 0.372 ∘ 0.372^{\circ} ; Table 14 ). Replacing GT with 4RC estimates on the same clips and checkpoint raises this error to 0.931 ∘ 0.931^{\circ} but barely changes relative rotation error ( 0.051 ∘ 0.051^{\circ} to 0.055 ∘ 0.055^{\circ} ), consistent with an orientation offset despite similar local motion. Accurate relative motion therefore does not guarantee the requested viewpoint.
paragraphs.zh: 在九个留出的 Syn4D 片段上使用真值源几何时，Holo4D 在全部五个相机指标上的误差都低于 Vista4D，包括源对齐旋转（0.242^{\circ} 对 0.372^{\circ}；表 14）。 在相同的片段和检查点上，用 4RC 估计值替换 GT 会将该误差提高到 0.931^{\circ}，但几乎不改变相对旋转误差（从 0.051^{\circ} 到 0.055^{\circ}），这与局部运动相似但存在朝向偏移的情况一致。 因此，准确的相对运动并不能保证所要求的视点。

paragraphs.en: Camera control on Vista4D trajectories. On Vista4D’s 110 110 trajectories ( Table 6 ), Vista4D uses its released Pi3 geometry and reprojections, while Holo4D uses 4RC or the two-stage backend (protocols in Appendix E ). With scalar-depth-aligned 4RC geometry, Holo4D has similar ATE, lower RPE-T and Pi3 translation error, but higher rotation errors than Vista4D. Substituting the two-stage backend cuts rotation error by 74 % 74\% under VGGT- Ω \Omega and 59 % 59\% under Pi3 ( 14.98 ∘ 14.98^{\circ} to 6.098 ∘ 6.098^{\circ} ), improves ATE and RPE-T, and slightly raises Pi3 translation error. Pi3 rotation remains above Vista4D’s 4.169 ∘ 4.169^{\circ} . The comparison with Vista4D does not isolate the generator.
paragraphs.zh: Vista4D 轨迹上的相机控制。 在 Vista4D 的 110 条轨迹（表 6）上，Vista4D 使用其发布的 Pi3 几何与重投影，而 Holo4D 使用 4RC 或两阶段后端（协议见附录 E）。 采用标量深度对齐的 4RC 几何时，Holo4D 与 Vista4D 相比具有相近的 ATE、更低的 RPE-T 和 Pi3 平移误差，但旋转误差更高。 替换为两阶段后端后，在 VGGT-Ω 下旋转误差降低 74%，在 Pi3 下降低 59%（从 14.98° 降至 6.098°），ATE 和 RPE-T 均有改善，Pi3 平移误差略有上升。 Pi3 旋转仍高于 Vista4D 的 4.169°。 与 Vista4D 的比较并不能单独隔离出生成器的作用。

paragraphs.en: Holo4D -14B is trained without robot videos, yet reshoots DROID manipulation episodes and humanoid-robot clips without fine-tuning ( Figures 5 and 17 ).
paragraphs.zh: Holo4D-14B 在训练时未使用机器人视频，却能在无需微调的情况下重新演绎 DROID 操作片段和人形机器人视频（图 5 和图 17）。

paragraphs.en: We generate overlapping 49 49 -frame windows: the first with Holo4D -14B, then with an image-to-video continuation model conditioned on the last generated frame ( Appendix B ). The continuation model trains on OmniWorld-DROID, so later windows are not zero-shot. Figure 6 qualitatively shows consistent appearance across two window boundaries in a 196 196 -frame episode.
paragraphs.zh: 我们生成重叠的 49 49 帧窗口：第一个使用 Holo4D -14B，随后使用一个以最后生成帧为条件的图像到视频延续模型（附录 B）。 该延续模型在 OmniWorld-DROID 上训练，因此后续窗口并非零样本。 图 6 定性地展示了在一个 196 196 帧的片段中，两个窗口边界之间外观保持一致。

paragraphs.en: We initialize Fast-WAM’s [ 65 ] 30 30 video self-attention blocks from a 5B Holo4D variant ( Appendix L ) and train on LIBERO [ 86 ] alongside a matched Wan2.2-initialized control ( Table 7 ). Results are mixed: LIBERO has few tasks and is near saturation ( 95.60 % 95.60\% vs. 96.45 % 96.45\% ), leaving little room to distinguish the two. On LIBERO-plus [ 87 ] , Holo4D gains 1.29 1.29 percentage points overall, mainly under background-texture ( + 7.1 +7.1 ) and lighting ( + 3.9 +3.9 ) perturbations, but loses on the spatial suite. Camera-viewpoint perturbations remain hard for all checkpoints (single seed). Whether novel-view training helps embodied policies remains open and merits further study.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从 5B 的 Holo4D 变体（附录 L）初始化 Fast-WAM 的 [65] 30 30 视频自注意力模块，并在 LIBERO [86] 上进行训练，同时对比一个使用 Wan2.2 初始化的匹配对照组（表 7）。 结果喜忧参半：LIBERO 任务较少且已接近饱和（95.60% 95.60\% 对 96.45% 96.45\%），几乎没有空间来区分二者。 在 LIBERO-plus [87] 上，Holo4D 总体提升 1.29 个百分点，主要来自背景纹理（+7.1 +7.1）和光照（+3.9 +3.9）扰动，但在空间套件上有所下降。 相机视角扰动对所有检查点来说仍然困难（单种子）。 新视角训练是否有助于具身策略仍悬而未决，值得进一步研究。

sents.en: Whether novel-view training helps embodied policies remains open and merits further study.
sents.zh: 新视角训练是否有助于具身策略仍悬而未决，值得进一步研究。

paragraphs.en: Holo4D guides video diffusion with persistent 3D trajectories that carry source appearance, leaving regions beyond the scaffold to the generative prior. It achieves the lowest trajectory and translation errors on DAVIS and the best PSNR and LPIPS on iPhone with the two-stage backend, and works with different reconstructors without retraining; it remains sensitive to geometric error, incomplete source coverage, and difficult camera trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: Holo4D 通过携带源外观的持久化三维轨迹来引导视频扩散，将支架之外的区域留给生成先验。 它借助两阶段后端在 DAVIS 上取得了最低的轨迹误差和平移误差，并在 iPhone 上取得了最佳的 PSNR 和 LPIPS，且无需重新训练即可适配不同的重建器；但它对几何误差、源覆盖不完整以及困难的相机轨迹仍然敏感。

sents.en: Holo4D guides video diffusion with persistent 3D trajectories that carry source appearance, leaving regions beyond the scaffold to the generative prior.
sents.zh: Holo4D 通过携带源外观的持久化三维轨迹来引导视频扩散，将支架之外的区域留给生成先验。

sents.en: It achieves the lowest trajectory and translation errors on DAVIS and the best PSNR and LPIPS on iPhone with the two-stage backend, and works with different reconstructors without retraining; it remains sensitive to geometric error, incomplete source coverage, and difficult camera trajectories.
sents.zh: 它借助两阶段后端在 DAVIS 上取得了最低的轨迹误差和平移误差，并在 iPhone 上取得了最佳的 PSNR 和 LPIPS，且无需重新训练即可适配不同的重建器；但它对几何误差、源覆盖不完整以及困难的相机轨迹仍然敏感。

paragraphs.en: Since video generators are general-purpose vision learners [ 88 ] , one model could jointly perform 4D reconstruction and novel-view synthesis so that both improve together. Querying trajectories in every source frame, not just the first (e.g., UniQueR [ 89 ] ), would cover later-appearing content; stronger base models such as MiniMax H3 [ 90 ] should improve visual quality.
paragraphs.zh: 由于视频生成器是通用的视觉学习器[88]，一个模型可以联合执行4D重建与新视角合成，使两者共同提升。 在每个源帧中查询轨迹，而不仅仅是第一帧（例如UniQueR[89]），将能覆盖后出现的内容；更强的基座模型如MiniMax H3[90]应能提升视觉质量。

paragraphs.en: The task, title, and central idea are unchanged: Holo4D exposes source-view 4D reconstruction to a pretrained video diffusion model to reshoot a monocular video along a new camera path. After review, we simplified conditioning, retrained the model, and expanded evaluation. Changed checkpoints, resolutions, and camera evaluators preclude direct comparison with submitted numbers. Table 8 summarizes the differences; the main one is that the rendered RGB-D (depth) branch is removed and only the 3D-track branch is kept. Figure 8 reproduces the submitted pipeline, and Figures 10 , 8 and 10 reproduce its qualitative results.
paragraphs.zh: 任务、标题和中心思想保持不变：Holo4D 将源视角的四维重建暴露给预训练的视频扩散模型，以便沿新的相机路径重新拍摄单目视频。 经评审后，我们简化了条件控制，重新训练了模型，并扩展了评估。 更改后的检查点、分辨率和相机评估器使得无法与提交时的数值进行直接比较。 表 8 总结了这些差异；主要的一点是移除了渲染的 RGB-D（深度）分支，仅保留三维轨迹分支。 图 8 复现了提交时的流程，图 10、8 和 10 复现了其定性结果。

sents.en: Table 8 summarizes the differences; the main one is that the rendered RGB-D (depth) branch is removed and only the 3D-track branch is kept.

paragraphs.en: The submitted paper described four conditioning signals: the source video, a hybrid RGB-D cache, target-camera Plücker rays, and 3D-track tokens. A 3D-motion threshold separated static and dynamic pixels. Static pixels were fused from K = 7 K=7 keyframes selected by farthest-point sampling over camera positions and viewing directions; dynamic pixels came from the synchronized source frame. The described design merged their renders by z-buffer selection into target-view RGB, normalized depth, and validity. Track tokens encoded 3D trajectory positions and were fused with the RGB-D tokens. The actual submitted 14B DAVIS and iPhone results used multiframe softsplat RGB-D conditioning; the 1.3B DAVIS results used single-frame z-buffer conditioning. Both included 3D tracks.
paragraphs.zh: 提交的论文描述了四种条件信号：源视频、混合 RGB-D 缓存、目标相机 Plücker 射线以及 3D 轨迹标记。 通过一个 3D 运动阈值区分静态像素和动态像素。 静态像素由 K = 7 K=7 个关键帧融合而成，这些关键帧通过在相机位置和观察方向上进行最远点采样选出；动态像素则来自同步的源帧。 所描述的设计通过 z-buffer 选择将其渲染结果合并为目标视角的 RGB、归一化深度和有效性掩码。 轨迹标记编码了 3D 轨迹位置，并与 RGB-D 标记进行融合。 实际提交的 14B DAVIS 和 iPhone 结果使用了多帧 softsplat RGB-D 条件化；1.3B 的 DAVIS 结果使用了单帧 z-buffer 条件化。两者都包含了 3D 轨迹。

sents.en: The submitted paper described four conditioning signals: the source video, a hybrid RGB-D cache, target-camera Plücker rays, and 3D-track tokens.
sents.zh: 提交的论文描述了四种条件信号：源视频、混合 RGB-D 缓存、目标相机 Plücker 射线以及 3D 轨迹标记。

sents.zh: 静态像素由 K = 7 K=7 个关键帧融合而成，这些关键帧通过在相机位置和观察方向上进行最远点采样选出；动态像素则来自同步的源帧。

sents.en: The described design merged their renders by z-buffer selection into target-view RGB, normalized depth, and validity.
sents.zh: 所描述的设计通过 z-buffer 选择将其渲染结果合并为目标视角的 RGB、归一化深度和有效性掩码。

sents.en: Track tokens encoded 3D trajectory positions and were fused with the RGB-D tokens.
sents.zh: 轨迹标记编码了 3D 轨迹位置，并与 RGB-D 标记进行融合。

sents.en: The actual submitted 14B DAVIS and iPhone results used multiframe softsplat RGB-D conditioning; the 1.3B DAVIS results used single-frame z-buffer conditioning. Both included 3D tracks.
sents.zh: 实际提交的 14B DAVIS 和 iPhone 结果使用了多帧 softsplat RGB-D 条件化；1.3B 的 DAVIS 结果使用了单帧 z-buffer 条件化。两者都包含了 3D 轨迹。

paragraphs.en: This version removes the rendered RGB-D branch, which supplied target-view RGB, depth, and validity, and keeps only the 3D-track branch, together with the source video and target-camera rays ( Section 3 , Figure 2 versus Figure 8 ). Observations encode source color and target-camera depth ( Equation 3 ); validity combines upstream validity with in-image projection, without the occlusion test of z-buffer visibility. Since a static point is a trajectory with a constant position, the static–dynamic threshold and keyframe selection are no longer needed. In a controlled stage-1 comparison, adding rendered RGB and masks to the trajectory features did not improve camera control ( Table 4 ); Tables 15 , 16 and 17 report further comparisons with rendered conditioning from earlier checkpoints. Track features enter every DiT block along channels and add no attention tokens ( Appendix J ).
paragraphs.zh: 该版本移除了渲染的 RGB-D 分支（该分支原本提供目标视角的 RGB、深度和有效性），仅保留三维轨迹分支，连同源视频与目标相机光线（第 3 节，图 2 对比图 8）。 观测编码源颜色和目标相机深度（公式 3）；有效性将上游有效性与图像内投影相结合，不再使用 z 缓冲可见性的遮挡测试。 由于静止点可视为位置恒定的轨迹，静态-动态阈值和关键帧选择均不再需要。 在受控的第一阶段对比中，向轨迹特征添加渲染的 RGB 和掩码并未改善相机控制（表 4）；表 15、16 和 17 报告了与早期检查点的渲染条件化的进一步对比。 轨迹特征沿通道进入每个 DiT 块，不增加注意力标记（附录 J）。

paragraphs.en: The submission reported a 14B model built on Wan2.1-I2V-14B and a 1.3B model built on Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, both trained at 144 × 256 144\times 256 and 288 × 512 288\times 512 . The main results in this version use a 14B model initialized from Wan2.1-T2V-14B and trained at 144 × 256 144\times 256 and then 384 × 672 384\times 672 , with a revised data mixture ( Appendices B and C ). Early 1.3B checkpoints appear only in the conditioning study of Table 15 , not as main results. The submission also probed target-view depth with a separately trained head on intermediate VAE decoder features; this version omits that probe and evaluates depth reconstructed from generated RGB videos ( Table 20 ).
paragraphs.zh: 提交版本报告了一个基于 Wan2.1-I2V-14B 构建的 14B 模型和一个基于 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 构建的 1.3B 模型，两者均在 144 × 256 144\times 256 和 288 × 512 288\times 512 分辨率下训练。 本版本的主要结果使用一个从 Wan2.1-T2V-14B 初始化的 14B 模型，在 144 × 256 144\times 256 分辨率下训练，然后在 384 × 672 384\times 672 分辨率下训练，并采用了修订后的数据配比（附录 B 和 C）。 早期的 1.3B 检查点仅出现在表 15 的条件控制研究中，而非作为主要结果。 提交版本还通过在中间 VAE 解码器特征上单独训练的探头来探测目标视角的深度；本版本省略了该探测，并评估了从生成的 RGB 视频中重建的深度（表 20）。

Video quality on DAVIS is measured with VBench; FVD is reported on Syn4D, where target-view references exist. New evaluations cover Vista4D’s 110 110 -trajectory benchmark ( Appendix E ), Syn4D with exact target RGB and geometry ( Appendix I ), per-scene optimization with ViDAR ( Table 18 ), alternative source reconstructors used without retraining, noise injected into the trajectories ( Tables 5 and 21 ), and runtime ( Appendix J ). paragraphs.en: For the DAVIS two-stage backend, GMOS [ 83 ] separates query-frame background and foreground identities. Background points are fixed at their query-frame 3D positions and kept valid; foreground points retain their depth-lifted trajectories and validity. Both enter the same track encoder, without additional mask channels or a separate foreground/background branch.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 DAVIS 两阶段后端，GMOS [83] 将查询帧的背景和前景身份分离。 背景点固定在其查询帧的 3D 位置并保持有效；前景点保留其深度提升的轨迹和有效性。 两者进入同一个轨迹编码器，无需额外的掩码通道或独立的前景/背景分支。

sents.en: For the DAVIS two-stage backend, GMOS [ 83 ] separates query-frame background and foreground identities.
sents.zh: 对于 DAVIS 两阶段后端，GMOS [83] 将查询帧的背景和前景身份分离。

sents.en: Background points are fixed at their query-frame 3D positions and kept valid; foreground points retain their depth-lifted trajectories and validity.
sents.zh: 背景点固定在其查询帧的 3D 位置并保持有效；前景点保留其深度提升的轨迹和有效性。

paragraphs.en: We initialize from Wan2.1-T2V-14B [ 70 ] , which has 40 40 DiT blocks and a 16 16 -channel video VAE with spatial compression 8 8 and temporal compression 4 4 . paragraphs.en: A sinusoidal encoding and MLP map observations to 32 32 -dimensional features. Target-view projection determines where to scatter these features, with channel-wise maximum aggregation and an occupancy indicator. Temporal patchification repeats the first frame to respect the VAE’s causal layout, then applies a 3D convolution with kernel and stride ( 4 , p , p ) (4,p,p) , where p p is the spatial downsampling factor, followed by one causal residual block and projection to 156 156 channels. The resulting features match the DiT token grid. Empty tokens use a learned, zero-initialized embedding. The source half of the width-concatenated latent sequence receives null track tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 正弦编码和多层感知机（MLP）将观测映射到 32 32 维特征。 目标视角投影决定将这些特征散射到何处，并采用逐通道最大值聚合和占用指示器。 时间分块通过重复第一帧来满足 VAE 的因果布局，然后应用核与步长为 ( 4 , p , p ) (4,p,p) 的 3D 卷积，其中 p p 是空间下采样因子，接着是一个因果残差块并投影到 156 156 个通道。 得到的特征与 DiT token 网格相匹配。 空 token 使用一个可学习且零初始化的嵌入。 宽度拼接的隐序列的前半部分接收空轨迹 token。

paragraphs.en: One shared camera encoder produces the target-camera features used in every DiT block. These features are repeated along width to match both source and target tokens. This repetition does not introduce source-camera rays; explicit source-camera rays would be compatible with this design but are untested. Each block has its own track concat–projection and camera output projector. Camera rays use the Plücker convention [ 𝐨 × 𝐝 , 𝐝 ] [\mathbf{o}\times\mathbf{d},\mathbf{d}] . Pixel unshuffle and a 2D convolution patchify the ray map; a zero-initialized pointwise 3D convolution maps its six channels to the DiT width. Within each block, track concatenation and projection follow normalization and timestep modulation. The camera feature is then added before self-attention, whose output passes through an identity-initialized camera projector and the gated residual connection. Cross-attention and the feed-forward sublayer follow.
paragraphs.zh: 一个共享的相机编码器生成每个 DiT 块中所使用的目标相机特征。 这些特征在宽度维度上重复，以同时匹配源相机与目标相机的词元。 这种重复不会引入源相机光线；显式的源相机光线与此设计兼容，但尚未经过测试。 每个块都有自己独立的轨迹拼接投影和相机输出投影器。 相机光线采用 Plücker 约定 [ 𝐨 × 𝐝 , 𝐝 ] [\mathbf{o}\times\mathbf{d},\mathbf{d}]。 通过像素混洗（pixel unshuffle）和一个二维卷积对光线图进行分块；再由一个零初始化的逐点三维卷积将其六个通道映射到 DiT 的宽度维度。 在每个块内，轨迹拼接与投影紧跟在归一化和时间步调制之后进行。 随后，相机特征在自注意力之前被加入，自注意力的输出经过一个恒等初始化的相机投影器和门控残差连接。 之后是交叉注意力和前馈子层。

sents.en: Pixel unshuffle and a 2D convolution patchify the ray map; a zero-initialized pointwise 3D convolution maps its six channels to the DiT width.

sents.zh: 在每个块内，轨迹拼接与投影紧跟在归一化和时间步调制之后进行。

sents.en: The camera feature is then added before self-attention, whose output passes through an identity-initialized camera projector and the gated residual connection.

sents.zh: 之后是交叉注意力和前馈子层。

paragraphs.en: A query-frame indicator identifies the source frames used to initialize trajectories. A binary sequence is one at the selected query frame and zero elsewhere; each value is broadcast over the image and repeated across three channels for encoding with the video VAE. The resulting control latents occupy the source half of the width-concatenated input, with zeros on the target half. A separate, zero-initialized Conv3D patch embedding maps these control latents to the hidden width, and its output is added to the video patch embeddings before the DiT blocks. This input addition uses neither the per-block track concat–projection nor a concatenation with the RGB latent channels.
paragraphs.zh: 查询帧指示器用于标识用于初始化轨迹的源帧。 二值序列在所选查询帧处为 1，其他位置为 0；每个数值会在图像上广播，并沿三个通道重复，以便用视频 VAE 进行编码。 得到的控制潜变量占据宽度拼接输入的源半部分，目标半部分为零。 一个独立的、零初始化的 Conv3D 块嵌入将这些控制潜变量映射到隐藏宽度，其输出在 DiT 块之前加到视频块嵌入上。 这种输入相加既不使用逐块的轨迹拼接-投影，也不与 RGB 潜变量通道进行拼接。

paragraphs.en: Stage 1 uses 49 49 frames at 144 × 256 144\times 256 for 15,000 15{,}000 steps, with effective batch size 8 8 and learning rate 1 × 10 − 5 1{\times}10^{-5} . Stage 2 continues the same checkpoint to step 19,500 19{,}500 at 384 × 672 384\times 672 , with effective batch size 32 32 and learning rate 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} on 32 32 GPUs using FSDP [ 91 ] . Both stages run on NVIDIA GH200 GPUs for about 24 24 hours each. Both stages optimize RGB flow matching. No geometric-conditioning dropout is used; text-conditioning dropout is 0.1 0.1 .

paragraphs.en: We extend generation beyond the 49 49 -frame training window by following Vista4D’s window-by-window inference [ 11 ] . (i) Split the source into 49 49 -frame windows with one-frame overlap: k k windows cover 49 + 48 ​ ( k − 1 ) 49+48(k-1) frames. Pad the last window by repeating its final source frame. (ii) Reconstruct each window independently using the backends specified below, querying trajectories at its first frame; identities are not shared across windows. Register each reconstruction to the first window through the shared boundary frame, holding its source camera fixed while fitting a scale to the shared point map. Use the corresponding segment of the requested target-camera path. (iii) Generate the first window with Holo4D -14B (step 19,500 19{,}500 ), conditioned on the source video, tracks, and cameras. (iv) Generate later windows with an image-to-video continuation model using the same conditions plus the previous window’s last generated frame. This shared boundary image is never a source or ground-truth frame. Remove duplicate boundary frames and padding when stitching.
paragraphs.zh: 我们沿用 Vista4D 的逐窗口推理 [11]，将生成扩展到 49 49 帧训练窗口之外。 (i) 以一帧重叠将源视频切分为 49 49 帧的窗口：k k 个窗口覆盖 49 + 48 ​ ( k − 1 ) 49+48(k-1) 帧。 通过重复其最后一个源帧来填充最后一个窗口。 (ii) 使用下述后端独立重建每个窗口，在其首帧查询轨迹；不同窗口之间不共享身份。 通过共享的边界帧将每次重建配准到第一个窗口，在拟合尺度到共享点图时保持其源相机固定。 使用所请求目标相机路径的对应片段。 (iii) 以源视频、轨迹和相机为条件，用 Holo4D -14B（第 19,500 19{,}500 步）生成第一个窗口。 (iv) 使用图像到视频的续接模型生成后续窗口，条件与之前相同，再加上前一个窗口最后生成的帧。 该共享边界图像从不是源帧或真值帧。 拼接时移除重复的边界帧和填充帧。

sents.en: We extend generation beyond the 49 49 -frame training window by following Vista4D’s window-by-window inference [ 11 ] .
sents.zh: 我们沿用 Vista4D 的逐窗口推理 [11]，将生成扩展到 49 49 帧训练窗口之外。

sents.en: (i) Split the source into 49 49 -frame windows with one-frame overlap: k k windows cover 49 + 48 ​ ( k − 1 ) 49+48(k-1) frames.
sents.zh: (i) 以一帧重叠将源视频切分为 49 49 帧的窗口：k k 个窗口覆盖 49 + 48 ​ ( k − 1 ) 49+48(k-1) 帧。

sents.en: Pad the last window by repeating its final source frame.
sents.zh: 通过重复其最后一个源帧来填充最后一个窗口。

sents.en: (ii) Reconstruct each window independently using the backends specified below, querying trajectories at its first frame; identities are not shared across windows.
sents.zh: (ii) 使用下述后端独立重建每个窗口，在其首帧查询轨迹；不同窗口之间不共享身份。

sents.en: Register each reconstruction to the first window through the shared boundary frame, holding its source camera fixed while fitting a scale to the shared point map.
sents.zh: 通过共享的边界帧将每次重建配准到第一个窗口，在拟合尺度到共享点图时保持其源相机固定。

sents.en: Use the corresponding segment of the requested target-camera path.
sents.zh: 使用所请求目标相机路径的对应片段。

sents.en: (iii) Generate the first window with Holo4D -14B (step 19,500 19{,}500 ), conditioned on the source video, tracks, and cameras.
sents.zh: (iii) 以源视频、轨迹和相机为条件，用 Holo4D -14B（第 19,500 19{,}500 步）生成第一个窗口。

sents.en: (iv) Generate later windows with an image-to-video continuation model using the same conditions plus the previous window’s last generated frame.
sents.zh: (iv) 使用图像到视频的续接模型生成后续窗口，条件与之前相同，再加上前一个窗口最后生成的帧。

sents.en: This shared boundary image is never a source or ground-truth frame.
sents.zh: 该共享边界图像从不是源帧或真值帧。

sents.en: Remove duplicate boundary frames and padding when stitching.
sents.zh: 拼接时移除重复的边界帧和填充帧。

paragraphs.en: The continuation model uses a Wan2.1-I2V-14B [ 70 ] backbone and the stage-1 Holo4D -14B track and camera modules. Its image condition enters through the first-frame VAE latent and CLIP image feature. During training, this is the first ground-truth target frame, dropped with probability 0.3 0.3 and noised at level 0.05 0.05 . Training proceeds at 144 × 256 144\times 256 from step 15,000 15{,}000 to 19,000 19{,}000 , then at 384 × 672 384\times 672 to step 22,500 22{,}500 , with effective batch size 32 32 and learning rate 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} . The mixture is MultiCamVideo ( 22.5 % 22.5\% ), Syn4D ( 30 % 30\% ), DL3DV ( 15 % 15\% ), MVS-Synth ( 7.5 % 7.5\% ), and OmniWorld-DROID [ 92 , 85 ] ( 25 % 25\% ); unlike Holo4D -14B, this model has seen robot videos. Window 1 uses 4RC for DROID and the two-stage backend for humanoid clips; later windows use 4RC without GMOS. Each 4RC reconstruction uses all 49 49 source frames. All windows use 50 50 denoising steps, CFG 5 5 , shift 5 5 , and seed 42 42 ( Figures 6 and 18 ).

paragraphs.en: Stage 1 combines Syn4D and two equally weighted Kubric subsets for dynamic scenes, together with real static scenes from DL3DV and RE10K and synthetic static scenes from MVS-Synth and TartanAir. Each Kubric subset contributes approximately 6.33 % 6.33\% of the stage-1 sampling weight. Stage 2 uses Syn4D and MultiCamVideo for dynamic scenes and DL3DV and MVS-Synth for static scenes, increasing the dynamic share from 44.30 % 44.30\% to 70 % 70\% .
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 1 将 Syn4D 与两个权重相同的 Kubric 子集（用于动态场景），以及来自 DL3DV 和 RE10K 的真实静态场景、来自 MVS-Synth 和 TartanAir 的合成静态场景结合在一起。 每个 Kubric 子集约占阶段 1 采样权重的 6.33 % 6.33\%。 阶段 2 使用 Syn4D 和 MultiCamVideo 作为动态场景，使用 DL3DV 和 MVS-Synth 作为静态场景，将动态场景的占比从 44.30 % 44.30\% 提高到 70 % 70\%。

paragraphs.en: For static scenes, we form source–target pairs from different chunks of the same monocular video, similar to 4Real-Video-V2 [ 79 ] ; temporal synchronization is unnecessary since the scene is static. Dynamic training pairs come from synchronized multiview videos; we do not use dynamic monocular videos for training.
paragraphs.zh: 对于静态场景，我们从同一段单目视频的不同片段构建源-目标配对，类似于 4Real-Video-V2 [ 79 ]；由于场景是静态的，因此无需进行时间同步。 动态训练配对来自同步的多视角视频；我们不使用动态单目视频进行训练。

paragraphs.en: We construct our DAVIS evaluation set by selecting 50 50 videos [ 80 ] and randomly sampling two target trajectories per video from the ReCamMaster [ 1 ] and Vista4D [ 11 ] trajectory pools. Baselines use released checkpoints and native generation resolutions; Vista4D uses 4RC-derived source geometry for this DAVIS comparison. We evaluate the first 49 49 output frames. Camera recovery with VGGT- Ω \Omega and Pi3 uses 384 × 672 384\times 672 frames; VBench uses the same resolution at 16 16 FPS with each clip’s caption. The main Holo4D result uses 4RC source depth, cameras, and dense tracks, with 50 50 denoising steps, CFG 5 5 , shift 5 5 , and seed 42 42 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过选取 50 个视频 [80] 并从 ReCamMaster [1] 和 Vista4D [11] 轨迹池中为每个视频随机采样两条目标轨迹来构建 DAVIS 评估集。 基线方法使用已发布的检查点和原生生成分辨率；在此 DAVIS 对比中 Vista4D 使用由 4RC 导出的源几何。 我们评估前 49 帧输出。 使用 VGGT-Ω 和 Pi3 的相机恢复采用 384×672 的帧；VBench 使用相同分辨率、16 FPS，并配有每个片段的描述文本。 Holo4D 的主要结果使用 4RC 的源深度、相机和稠密轨迹，采用 50 个去噪步、CFG 为 5、shift 为 5、随机种子为 42。

paragraphs.en: VGGT- Ω \Omega recovers cameras from generated videos. Translation metrics use the 54 54 translation-bearing trajectories; rotation uses all 100 100 . DAVIS has no captured target-view reference for these paths, so we report camera control and VBench scores. All methods are evaluated with the same VGGT- Ω \Omega evaluator revision on all 100 100 videos; baseline videos are the stored outputs of their released models, not resampled. For ATE and RPE-T, we anchor both trajectories at their first camera and rescale the predicted camera centers to match the centered Frobenius norm of the requested centers. We average per-video RMSEs; relative errors use adjacent frames. No subsequent global rotation alignment is applied to ATE, so orientation errors after the first frame contribute to it. Its magnitude also depends on the requested trajectories and is not directly comparable across DAVIS and Vista4D trajectory sets.
paragraphs.zh: VGGT-Ω \Omega 从生成的视频中恢复相机。 平移指标使用 54 54 条包含平移的轨迹；旋转则使用全部 100 100 条。 DAVIS 对这些路径没有捕获的目标视角参考，因此我们报告相机控制和 VBench 分数。 所有方法都在全部 100 100 个视频上使用相同的 VGGT-Ω \Omega 评估器版本进行评估；基线视频是其已发布模型的存储输出，而非重新采样。 对于 ATE 和 RPE-T，我们将两条轨迹锚定在其首个相机上，并对预测的相机中心进行缩放，以匹配所请求中心的中心化 Frobenius 范数。 我们对每个视频的 RMSE 取平均；相对误差使用相邻帧。 ATE 不进行后续的全局旋转对齐，因此首帧之后的朝向误差会计入其中。 其大小还取决于所请求的轨迹，因此在 DAVIS 与 Vista4D 轨迹集之间不可直接比较。

paragraphs.en: On one H200 with 50 50 denoising steps and 49 49 frames, Holo4D -5B generates a 704 × 1280 704\times 1280 video in 202.0 202.0 s on average, versus 417.4 417.4 s for Holo4D -14B at 384 × 672 384\times 672 and 495.0 495.0 s for Vista4D at 384 × 672 384\times 672 (plus 6.2 6.2 s of point-cloud rendering), averaged over the same 100 100 Vista4D trajectory pairs; peak GPU memory is 76.3 76.3 , 43.2 43.2 , and 49.9 49.9 GiB, respectively. For these two configurations, the measured sampling time of the 5B model is about 2.1 × 2.1\times lower than that of the 14B model; because backbone, resolution, and track condition all differ, this is not a speedup under matched conditions. These are complete sampling times with precomputed source reconstruction from the 100 100 -pair evaluation runs, not the matched two-trajectory profiling in Table 24 , so the 14B totals differ between the two measurements.

paragraphs.en: The shared trajectory representation supports foreground/background fusion without modifying the generator: for the two-stage backend, background points are held fixed in 3D while foreground points keep their tracked motion, and a foreground mask decides which is which. Our default 4RC condition uses no explicit fusion.
paragraphs.zh: 共享的轨迹表示支持在不修改生成器的情况下进行前景/背景融合：对于两阶段后端，背景点在3D空间中保持固定，而前景点保持其被跟踪的运动，前景掩码决定哪些点属于前景、哪些属于背景。 我们默认的 4RC 条件不使用显式融合。

paragraphs.en: We additionally evaluate on the 110 110 native Vista4D trajectories with both generated-only VGGT- Ω \Omega recovery and Vista4D’s source-aligned Pi3 protocol ( Table 6 ). Vista4D uses the benchmark’s released Pi3 reconstruction, masks, and rendered inputs, whereas Holo4D uses 4RC or the two-stage backend. This preserves Vista4D’s native preprocessing and compares complete pipelines; it does not isolate the video generator as the source of performance differences. For the qualitative comparisons in Figures 3 and 16 , baselines use their released sampling settings and the benchmark’s released Pi3 geometry where a point cloud is required; Vista4D videos are its official outputs. The VGGT- Ω \Omega and Pi3 evaluators recover cameras for scoring and are separate from the source reconstruction used for generation. With 4RC source geometry, Holo4D has lower RPE-T under VGGT- Ω \Omega and lower translation error under Pi3, but higher rotation error under both evaluators. VGGT- Ω \Omega evaluation follows the normalization in Appendix D . ATE and RPE-T have 110 110 valid values for Holo4D with 4RC and 109 109 each for Vista4D and the two-stage condition; RPE-R uses all 110 110 . These are per-method valid-metric counts, not a common-subset evaluation. Scale normalization requires non-degenerate requested and recovered camera paths; a completed video can therefore lack a valid translation metric. Vista4D’s Pi3 protocol reconstructs source and generated frames jointly, then aligns the source cameras by Sim ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{Sim}(3) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们还在110条原生Vista4D轨迹上进行了评估，同时采用仅由生成结果驱动的VGGT-Ω重建和Vista4D的源对齐Pi3协议（表6）。 Vista4D使用基准测试发布的Pi3重建、掩码和渲染输入，而Holo4D使用4RC或两阶段后端。 这保留了Vista4D的原生预处理并比较了完整流程；它并未将视频生成器隔离为性能差异的来源。 对于图3和图16中的定性比较，基线方法使用其发布的采样设置，并且在需要点云时使用基准测试发布的Pi3几何；Vista4D视频是其官方输出。 VGGT-Ω和Pi3评估器为评分恢复相机，与用于生成的源重建是分开的。 使用4RC源几何时，Holo4D在VGGT-Ω下具有更低的RPE-T，在Pi3下具有更低的平移误差，但在两个评估器下旋转误差都更高。 VGGT-Ω评估遵循附录D中的归一化方式。 ATE和RPE-T在4RC的Holo4D上有110个有效值，Vista4D和两阶段条件各有109个有效值；RPE-R使用全部110个。 这些是各方法的有效指标数量，而非共同子集评估。 尺度归一化要求请求的和恢复的相机路径非退化；因此一段已完成的视频可能缺乏有效的平移指标。 Vista4D的Pi3协议将源帧和生成帧联合重建，然后通过Sim(3)对齐源相机。

sents.en: With 4RC source geometry, Holo4D has lower RPE-T under VGGT- Ω \Omega and lower translation error under Pi3, but higher rotation error under both evaluators.
sents.zh: 使用4RC源几何时，Holo4D在VGGT-Ω下具有更低的RPE-T，在Pi3下具有更低的平移误差，但在两个评估器下旋转误差都更高。

sents.en: VGGT- Ω \Omega evaluation follows the normalization in Appendix D .
sents.zh: VGGT-Ω评估遵循附录D中的归一化方式。

sents.en: ATE and RPE-T have 110 110 valid values for Holo4D with 4RC and 109 109 each for Vista4D and the two-stage condition; RPE-R uses all 110 110 .

sents.en: These are per-method valid-metric counts, not a common-subset evaluation.

sents.en: Scale normalization requires non-degenerate requested and recovered camera paths; a completed video can therefore lack a valid translation metric.
sents.zh: 尺度归一化要求请求的和恢复的相机路径非退化；因此一段已完成的视频可能缺乏有效的平移指标。

sents.en: Vista4D’s Pi3 protocol reconstructs source and generated frames jointly, then aligns the source cameras by Sim ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{Sim}(3) .
sents.zh: Vista4D的Pi3协议将源帧和生成帧联合重建，然后通过Sim(3)对齐源相机。

paragraphs.en: The 4RC condition in Table 6 uses its reconstructed trajectories without mask-guided fusion and aligns the geometry to the released camera coordinate system with a per-video scalar depth factor. Thus the source-condition comparison includes alignment effects, and the two evaluators disagree on this preprocessing change.

paragraphs.en: Section 4.4 analyzes the ground-truth and 4RC comparisons in Table 14 . All rows use nine held-out Syn4D flying_group clips, with source camera 0 0 and target camera 1 1 . paragraphs.en: On Vista4D’s native trajectories, source replacement changes camera estimates, geometry, and coverage together. Separating generator sensitivity from reconstruction error would require running both methods with the same estimated geometry on these trajectories.

paragraphs.en: To ask whether richer geometric conditions repair rotation, we compare four separately trained 1.3B checkpoints that add rendered RGB-D, tracks, and multi-frame rendering to Plücker camera rays ( Table 15 ). The Pi3 translation error decreases monotonically from 0.987 0.987 to 0.685 0.685 as conditions are added, whereas rotation error does not decrease; rendered RGB-D raises it by 2.33 ∘ 2.33^{\circ} (95% confidence interval [ 0.18 ∘ , 4.73 ∘ ] [0.18^{\circ},4.73^{\circ}] over the 20 20 pairs). These early checkpoints barely follow the requested rotation, so the experiment shows only that added geometric conditions improve translation more readily than rotation; it does not measure the rotation accuracy of the final model. All four Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B checkpoints are evaluated at step 3,000 3{,}000 , using the same 4RC reconstructions, 288 × 512 × 49 288\times 512\times 49 outputs, and 50 50 denoising steps. The 20 20 pairs come from ten sources, five selected for rotation failures, with metrics as in Table 6 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了探究更丰富的几何条件能否修复旋转问题，我们比较了四个分别训练的 1.3B 检查点，它们在 Plücker 相机光线的基础上增加了渲染的 RGB-D、轨迹和多帧渲染（表 15）。 随着条件的增加，Pi3 的平移误差从 0.987 单调下降到 0.685，而旋转误差并未下降；渲染的 RGB-D 使其上升了 2.33°（在 20 组配对上的 95% 置信区间为 [0.18°, 4.73°]）。 这些早期检查点几乎无法遵循所要求的旋转，因此该实验仅表明增加的几何条件更容易改善平移而非旋转；它并未衡量最终模型的旋转精度。 所有四个 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 检查点均在第 3,000 步进行评估，使用相同的 4RC 重建、288×512×49 的输出以及 50 个去噪步骤。 这 20 组配对来自十个来源，其中五个因旋转失败而被选中，指标与表 6 相同。

paragraphs.en: We use the five iPhone/DyCheck scenes and source–target split of Vista4D [ 11 ] . One synchronized camera supplies the source video and a held-out camera supplies the target trajectory and reference RGB. Target references and masks are center-cropped to 16 : 9 16{:}9 and resized to 288 × 512 288\times 512 . Predictions are resized to the same canvas and evaluated over 49 49 frames; EX-4D’s square outputs are resized directly, without an additional center crop. Masked metrics use the intersection of valid and co-visible pixels, not a foreground-object mask. The two Holo4D rows share the same checkpoint and use 50 50 denoising steps, CFG 5 5 , shift 5 5 , and seed 42 42 . For both source conditions, source depth, cameras, and tracks are calibrated per scene to the source iPhone LiDAR scale.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用五个 iPhone/DyCheck 场景以及 Vista4D [ 11 ] 的源-目标划分。 一台同步相机提供源视频，一台留出的相机提供目标轨迹和参考 RGB。 目标参考和掩码被中心裁剪为 16 : 9 16{:}9 并缩放至 288 × 512 288\times 512 。 预测结果被缩放到相同的画布并在 49 49 帧上进行评估；EX-4D 的方形输出被直接缩放，不进行额外的中心裁剪。 掩码指标使用有效像素和共同可见像素的交集，而非前景物体掩码。 两个 Holo4D 行共享同一检查点，使用 50 50 个去噪步数、CFG 5 5 、shift 5 5 和种子 42 42 。 对于两种源条件，源深度、相机和轨迹均按场景标定到源 iPhone LiDAR 的尺度。

paragraphs.en: Table 18 compares with ViDAR [ 26 ] on the same five scenes. ViDAR is optimized per scene using only the first 49 49 source frames, with outputs evaluated at 288 × 512 288\times 512 . This distinguishes scene-specific optimization from amortized generation, but is not a hardware-matched speed comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 表 18 在相同的五个场景上与 ViDAR [26] 进行了比较。 ViDAR 仅使用前 49 个源帧针对每个场景进行优化，输出在 288 × 512 分辨率下评估。 采用两阶段后端时，Holo4D 在 PSNR 和 LPIPS 上更优，而 ViDAR 在 SSIM 上更优；在掩码指标上也保持同样的排序。 ViDAR 在 A6000 上平均每个场景耗时 5 小时 18 分钟。 这区分了针对特定场景的优化与摊销式生成，但并非硬件对齐的速度比较。

paragraphs.en: The Syn4D evaluation with ground-truth source geometry uses five held-out source clips and 32 32 source–target pairs with exact target RGB and depth. Rendered-geometry baselines use ground-truth source depth and cameras to reproject source RGB; Holo4D uses ground-truth 3D tracks, and ReCamMaster uses source RGB and cameras. No method receives target RGB, depth, or masks. Target-view image metrics compare directly against rendered target RGB. Syn4D also contributes training data for Holo4D , whereas baseline checkpoints are not adapted to it. The held-out real-capture results provide a complementary test. Holo4D uses 25 25 denoising steps at 384 × 672 384\times 672 for the ground-truth-source comparison and the reconstruction-backend and track-corruption studies ( Tables 3 , 21 and 21 ). Cameras are recovered with VGGT- Ω \Omega in both Syn4D comparisons. For these comparisons and the scaffold studies, ATE is the mean of per-pair trajectory RMSEs after Sim ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{Sim}(3) alignment, including rotation, translation, and scale. This differs from the first-frame-anchored, scale-normalized ATE used on DAVIS and the native Vista4D trajectories ( Appendices D and E ); ATE values should therefore be compared within each evaluation setting. Image metrics and FVD use ground-truth target videos as references, including the upstream-replacement and track-corruption studies on the same 32 32 ground-truth-source pairs. FVD in Tables 3 and 19 uses the same I3D scorer at 288 × 512 × 49 288\times 512\times 49 ; the two tables still evaluate different pairs, so their values should not be compared with each other. The FVD column of Table 21 comes from an earlier scoring at 256 × 256 256\times 256 and is comparable only within that table.
paragraphs.zh: 具有真实源几何的 Syn4D 评估使用五个留出的源片段和 32 32 个源–目标配对，目标 RGB 与深度均为精确值。 渲染几何基线使用真实源深度与相机来重投影源 RGB；Holo4D 使用真实 3D 轨迹，ReCamMaster 使用源 RGB 与相机。 任何方法都不接收目标 RGB、深度或掩码。 目标视角图像指标直接与渲染的目标 RGB 进行比较。 Syn4D 还为 Holo4D 提供了训练数据，而基线检查点并未在其上进行适配。 留出的真实采集结果提供了一项补充测试。 在真实源对比以及重建后端与轨迹损坏研究中（表 3 与表 21），Holo4D 以 384 × 672 384\times 672 的分辨率使用 25 25 个去噪步数。 在两项 Syn4D 对比中，相机均通过 VGGT- Ω \Omega 恢复。 在这些对比以及脚手架研究中，ATE 是经过 Sim ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{Sim}(3) 对齐（包括旋转、平移与缩放）后各配对轨迹 RMSE 的平均值。 这不同于在 DAVIS 和原生 Vista4D 轨迹上使用的以首帧为锚点、经尺度归一化的 ATE（附录 D 与附录 E）；因此 ATE 数值应在各自评估设置内部进行比较。 图像指标与 FVD 以真实目标视频作为参考，包括在相同 32 32 个真实源配对上进行的上游替换与轨迹损坏研究。 表 3 与表 19 中的 FVD 使用相同的 I3D 评分器，分辨率为 288 × 512 × 49 288\times 512\times 49；这两张表评估的是不同配对，因此其数值不应相互比较。 表 21 的 FVD 列来自早期在 256 × 256 256\times 256 分辨率下的评分，仅可在该表内部进行比较。

sents.en: The Syn4D evaluation with ground-truth source geometry uses five held-out source clips and 32 32 source–target pairs with exact target RGB and depth.
sents.zh: 具有真实源几何的 Syn4D 评估使用五个留出的源片段和 32 32 个源–目标配对，目标 RGB 与深度均为精确值。

sents.en: Rendered-geometry baselines use ground-truth source depth and cameras to reproject source RGB; Holo4D uses ground-truth 3D tracks, and ReCamMaster uses source RGB and cameras.
sents.zh: 渲染几何基线使用真实源深度与相机来重投影源 RGB；Holo4D 使用真实 3D 轨迹，ReCamMaster 使用源 RGB 与相机。

sents.en: No method receives target RGB, depth, or masks.
sents.zh: 任何方法都不接收目标 RGB、深度或掩码。

sents.en: Target-view image metrics compare directly against rendered target RGB.
sents.zh: 目标视角图像指标直接与渲染的目标 RGB 进行比较。

sents.en: Syn4D also contributes training data for Holo4D , whereas baseline checkpoints are not adapted to it.
sents.zh: Syn4D 还为 Holo4D 提供了训练数据，而基线检查点并未在其上进行适配。

sents.en: The held-out real-capture results provide a complementary test.
sents.zh: 留出的真实采集结果提供了一项补充测试。

sents.en: Holo4D uses 25 25 denoising steps at 384 × 672 384\times 672 for the ground-truth-source comparison and the reconstruction-backend and track-corruption studies ( Tables 3 , 21 and 21 ).
sents.zh: 在真实源对比以及重建后端与轨迹损坏研究中（表 3 与表 21），Holo4D 以 384 × 672 384\times 672 的分辨率使用 25 25 个去噪步数。

sents.en: Cameras are recovered with VGGT- Ω \Omega in both Syn4D comparisons.
sents.zh: 在两项 Syn4D 对比中，相机均通过 VGGT- Ω \Omega 恢复。

sents.en: For these comparisons and the scaffold studies, ATE is the mean of per-pair trajectory RMSEs after Sim ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{Sim}(3) alignment, including rotation, translation, and scale.
sents.zh: 在这些对比以及脚手架研究中，ATE 是经过 Sim ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{Sim}(3) 对齐（包括旋转、平移与缩放）后各配对轨迹 RMSE 的平均值。

sents.en: This differs from the first-frame-anchored, scale-normalized ATE used on DAVIS and the native Vista4D trajectories ( Appendices D and E ); ATE values should therefore be compared within each evaluation setting.
sents.zh: 这不同于在 DAVIS 和原生 Vista4D 轨迹上使用的以首帧为锚点、经尺度归一化的 ATE（附录 D 与附录 E）；因此 ATE 数值应在各自评估设置内部进行比较。

sents.en: Image metrics and FVD use ground-truth target videos as references, including the upstream-replacement and track-corruption studies on the same 32 32 ground-truth-source pairs.
sents.zh: 图像指标与 FVD 以真实目标视频作为参考，包括在相同 32 32 个真实源配对上进行的上游替换与轨迹损坏研究。

sents.en: FVD in Tables 3 and 19 uses the same I3D scorer at 288 × 512 × 49 288\times 512\times 49 ; the two tables still evaluate different pairs, so their values should not be compared with each other.
sents.zh: 表 3 与表 19 中的 FVD 使用相同的 I3D 评分器，分辨率为 288 × 512 × 49 288\times 512\times 49；这两张表评估的是不同配对，因此其数值不应相互比较。

sents.en: The FVD column of Table 21 comes from an earlier scoring at 256 × 256 256\times 256 and is comparable only within that table.
sents.zh: 表 21 的 FVD 列来自早期在 256 × 256 256\times 256 分辨率下的评分，仅可在该表内部进行比较。

paragraphs.en: Using source videos as FVD references, as in Vista4D [ 11 ] , measures distributional similarity to the inputs and does not establish adherence to the requested target views. A model that returns the source videos unchanged would obtain zero FVD, up to numerical precision under identical preprocessing, even when the requested cameras differ. We therefore report FVD only on Syn4D against ground-truth target videos. FVD remains a distribution-level video-quality metric; camera adherence is evaluated separately using recovered camera trajectories. We assess video quality with VBench ( Table 2 ) and target-referenced FVD; CLIP-based scores are not reported.
paragraphs.zh: 以源视频作为 FVD 参照（如 Vista4D [11]），衡量的是与输入之间的分布相似性，并不能确立对所请求目标视角的遵从性。 一个原样返回源视频的模型，在相同预处理下除数值精度误差外即可获得零 FVD，即使所请求的相机并不相同。 因此，我们仅在 Syn4D 上针对真实目标视频报告 FVD。 FVD 仍然是一个分布层面的视频质量指标；相机遵从性则使用恢复出的相机轨迹另行评估。 我们使用 VBench（表 2）和以目标为参照的 FVD 来评估视频质量；不报告基于 CLIP 的分数。

sents.en: Using source videos as FVD references, as in Vista4D [ 11 ] , measures distributional similarity to the inputs and does not establish adherence to the requested target views.
sents.zh: 以源视频作为 FVD 参照（如 Vista4D [11]），衡量的是与输入之间的分布相似性，并不能确立对所请求目标视角的遵从性。
