sents.zh: 一个原样返回源视频的模型，在相同预处理下除数值精度误差外即可获得零 FVD，即使所请求的相机并不相同。

sents.en: We therefore report FVD only on Syn4D against ground-truth target videos.
sents.zh: 因此，我们仅在 Syn4D 上针对真实目标视频报告 FVD。

sents.en: FVD remains a distribution-level video-quality metric; camera adherence is evaluated separately using recovered camera trajectories.
sents.zh: FVD 仍然是一个分布层面的视频质量指标；相机遵从性则使用恢复出的相机轨迹另行评估。

sents.en: We assess video quality with VBench ( Table 2 ) and target-referenced FVD; CLIP-based scores are not reported.
sents.zh: 我们使用 VBench（表 2）和以目标为参照的 FVD 来评估视频质量；不报告基于 CLIP 的分数。

paragraphs.en: Table 19 uses 32 32 pairs from 16 16 held-out flying_group scenes, with camera pairs → 7 0\!\rightarrow\!7 and → 6 2\!\rightarrow\!6 . Geometry-consuming methods receive 4RC source estimates. Holo4D uses 50 50 denoising steps at 384 × 672 384\times 672 and has the lowest camera errors and LPIPS; ReCamMaster has the highest PSNR and SSIM, while Vista4D has the lowest FVD. FVD compares all methods against the same 32 32 target videos at 288 × 512 288\times 512 over 49 49 frames; the small sample size makes it a supplementary distributional measure. This test set differs from the ground-truth-source experiment, so differences in their means do not isolate reconstruction error. All methods use the same neutral prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 表19使用了来自16个16个保留的 flying_group 场景的32个32对数据，相机对为 → 7 0\!\rightarrow\!7 和 → 6 2\!\rightarrow\!6。 消耗几何信息的方法接收 4RC 的源估计。 Holo4D 在 384 × 672 384\times 672 分辨率下使用50个50个去噪步骤，具有最低的相机误差和 LPIPS；ReCamMaster 具有最高的 PSNR 和 SSIM，而 Vista4D 具有最低的 FVD。 FVD 将所有方法与相同的32个32个目标视频在 288 × 512 288\times 512 分辨率下、49个49帧进行比较；样本量较小，因此它仅作为补充性的分布度量。 该测试集与真值来源实验不同，因此两者均值之间的差异并不能单独反映重建误差。 所有方法均使用相同的中间性提示。

sents.en: Table 19 uses 32 32 pairs from 16 16 held-out flying_group scenes, with camera pairs → 7 0\!\rightarrow\!7 and → 6 2\!\rightarrow\!6 .
sents.zh: 表19使用了来自16个16个保留的 flying_group 场景的32个32对数据，相机对为 → 7 0\!\rightarrow\!7 和 → 6 2\!\rightarrow\!6。

paragraphs.en: On the Syn4D test with ground-truth source geometry, depth reconstructed from generated RGB with either VGGT- Ω \Omega or 4RC is compared against exact target depth. On iPhone/DyCheck, each reconstructor is applied to both generated and held-out target RGB; the target reconstruction serves as a pseudo-depth reference. For both Syn4D depth evaluators, each 49 49 -frame prediction is aligned to exact target depth by one robust median scale over the full video, with no per-frame alignment. Metrics are weighted by the number of valid pixels when aggregated over source–target pairs. Valid pixels have finite positive predicted and reference depths and pass the evaluator’s confidence threshold at the fifth percentile. In Table 20 , columns identify the output-depth evaluator; the iPhone Holo4D row labels identify the source reconstructor used for generation. Both source conditions are evaluated with both output reconstructors. We define δ 1 \delta_{1} as the fraction of pixels with max ⁡ ( d ^ / d , d / d ^ ) < 1.25 \max(\hat{d}/d,d/\hat{d})<1.25 .
paragraphs.zh: 在使用真实源几何的 Syn4D 测试中，由生成的 RGB 经 VGGT-Ω\Omega 或 4RC 重建的深度与精确目标深度进行比较。 在 iPhone/DyCheck 上，每个重建器同时应用于生成的和留出的目标 RGB；目标重建结果作为伪深度参考。 对于两个 Syn4D 深度评估器，每个 49 帧的预测通过整个视频上的一个稳健中位数尺度对齐到精确目标深度，不做逐帧对齐。 在对源–目标对进行聚合时，指标按有效像素数量加权。 有效像素需具有有限的正预测深度和参考深度，并通过评估器置信度阈值的第五百分位。 在表 20 中，各列标识输出深度评估器；iPhone Holo4D 行标签标识用于生成的源重建器。 两种源条件均用两种输出重建器进行评估。 我们将 δ1\delta_{1} 定义为满足 max⁡(d^/d,d/d^)<1.25\max(\hat{d}/d,d/\hat{d})<1.25 的像素所占的比例。

sents.en: On the Syn4D test with ground-truth source geometry, depth reconstructed from generated RGB with either VGGT- Ω \Omega or 4RC is compared against exact target depth.
sents.zh: 在使用真实源几何的 Syn4D 测试中，由生成的 RGB 经 VGGT-Ω\Omega 或 4RC 重建的深度与精确目标深度进行比较。

sents.zh: 在 iPhone/DyCheck 上，每个重建器同时应用于生成的和留出的目标 RGB；目标重建结果作为伪深度参考。

sents.en: For both Syn4D depth evaluators, each 49 49 -frame prediction is aligned to exact target depth by one robust median scale over the full video, with no per-frame alignment.
sents.zh: 对于两个 Syn4D 深度评估器，每个 49 帧的预测通过整个视频上的一个稳健中位数尺度对齐到精确目标深度，不做逐帧对齐。

sents.zh: 在对源–目标对进行聚合时，指标按有效像素数量加权。

sents.en: Valid pixels have finite positive predicted and reference depths and pass the evaluator’s confidence threshold at the fifth percentile.
sents.zh: 有效像素需具有有限的正预测深度和参考深度，并通过评估器置信度阈值的第五百分位。

sents.en: In Table 20 , columns identify the output-depth evaluator; the iPhone Holo4D row labels identify the source reconstructor used for generation.
sents.zh: 在表 20 中，各列标识输出深度评估器；iPhone Holo4D 行标签标识用于生成的源重建器。

paragraphs.en: For hidden features 𝐡 ∈ ℝ L × D \mathbf{h}\in\mathbb{R}^{L\times D} and track features 𝐓 ∈ ℝ L × 156 \mathbf{T}\in\mathbb{R}^{L\times 156} , each injector projects [ 𝐡 ; 𝐓 ] ∈ ℝ L × ( D + 156 ) [\mathbf{h};\mathbf{T}]\in\mathbb{R}^{L\times(D+156)} back to ℝ L × D \mathbb{R}^{L\times D} . Self-attention therefore keeps the same sequence length, avoiding Vista4D’s additional rendered-video tokens [ 11 ] . Source-video tokens, adapters, and per-block projections still incur cost; fewer tokens do not imply a proportional reduction in total memory.
paragraphs.zh: 对于隐藏特征 𝐡 ∈ ℝ^(L×D) 和轨迹特征 𝐓 ∈ ℝ^(L×156)，每个注入器将 [𝐡; 𝐓] ∈ ℝ^(L×(D+156)) 投影回 ℝ^(L×D)。 因此，自注意力保持了相同的序列长度，避免了 Vista4D 额外引入的渲染视频令牌 [11]。 源视频令牌、适配器以及每个块的投影仍然会产生开销；更少的令牌并不意味着总内存按比例减少。

paragraphs.en: Fine dynamic structures such as hands can remain inconsistent across views, and large disoccluded regions are completed by the generative prior without geometric support, so their appearance can be implausible. The conditioning does not remove these failures; we expect stronger base models to reduce them while keeping the same interface.
paragraphs.zh: 像手部这类精细的动态结构在不同视角之间可能保持不一致，而大面积被重新遮挡的区域由生成先验在没有几何支撑的情况下补全，因此其外观可能显得不合理。 这种条件控制并不能消除这些失败；我们期望更强的基座模型能在保持相同接口的同时减少这些问题。

paragraphs.en: With first-frame queries, objects that enter the source video later may have no corresponding trajectories. The generator still receives their appearance in the source video, but must infer their target-view placement without direct geometric support. Figure 19 illustrates this case for a person entering the DAVIS india sequence. Because changing the camera can change when a person becomes visible, this example illustrates missing scaffold coverage rather than a measured timing error.
paragraphs.zh: 使用首帧查询时，较晚才进入源视频的物体可能没有对应的轨迹。 生成器仍然能接收到它们在源视频中的外观，但必须在缺乏直接几何支持的情况下推断它们在目标视角中的位置。 图 19 展示了 DAVIS india 序列中一个进入画面的人物的这种情况。 由于更换相机会改变人物何时变得可见，该示例说明的是脚手架覆盖的缺失，而非实测的时序误差。

paragraphs.en: Fast-WAM [ 65 ] couples a Wan2.2-TI2V-5B video expert with an action expert. Both arms share the Wan2.2-TI2V-5B weights, VAE, action-expert initialization, and cached text features. The Holo4D arm replaces 30 30 video self-attention blocks ( 300 300 tensors) with those from a 5B image-to-video variant at step 29,500 29{,}500 , warm-started from a video-to-video Holo4D -5B model. This is distinct from the step- 29,000 29{,}000 no-identity variant in Table 12 ; its pretraining mixture includes OmniWorld-DROID robot videos. Track, camera, and domain modules are discarded because Fast-WAM lacks them. Both arms train the full model, including the transferred blocks, for 20,000 20{,}000 steps on the four LIBERO [ 86 ] suites with identical data order, normalization, seed, and optimization settings. The official release is a separate reference. All checkpoints are evaluated with the Fast-WAM closed-loop evaluator: LIBERO uses 10 10 tasks per suite and 50 50 trials per task ( 2,000 2{,}000 rollouts per checkpoint); LIBERO-plus [ 87 ] uses all 10,030 10{,}030 perturbed tasks with one trial each. Per-suite results are in Table 25 and are discussed in Section 4.5 . On LIBERO-plus, Holo4D improves the goal suite ( + 6.2 +6.2 ) but drops 4.8 4.8 points on the spatial suite. All runs use a single seed.
paragraphs.zh: Fast-WAM [65] 将一个 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B 视频专家与一个动作专家相耦合。 两个分支共享 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B 权重、VAE、动作专家初始化以及缓存的文本特征。 Holo4D 分支在第 29,500 29{,}500 步时，将 30 30 个视频自注意力块（300 300 张量）替换为来自 5B 图像到视频变体的对应块，并以视频到视频的 Holo4D -5B 模型进行热启动。 这与 Table 12 中第 29,000 29{,}000 步的无身份变体不同；其预训练混合数据包含 OmniWorld-DROID 机器人视频。 由于 Fast-WAM 不具备轨迹、相机和域模块，因此这些模块被舍弃。 两个分支都训练完整模型（包括迁移过来的块），在四个 LIBERO [86] 套件上以完全相同的数据顺序、归一化、随机种子和优化设置训练 20,000 20{,}000 步。 官方发布版本作为单独的参考。 所有检查点均使用 Fast-WAM 闭环评估器进行评估：LIBERO 对每个套件使用 10 10 个任务、每个任务 50 50 次试验（每个检查点 2,000 2{,}000 次 rollout）；LIBERO-plus [87] 使用全部 10,030 10{,}030 个扰动任务，每个任务一次试验。 各套件的结果见 Table 25，并在 Section 4.5 中讨论。 在 LIBERO-plus 上，Holo4D 提升了 goal 套件（+6.2 +6.2），但在 spatial 套件上下降了 4.8 4.8 分。 所有运行均使用单个随机种子。

paragraphs.en: Controllable novel-view video synthesis can support content creation, immersive media, simulation, and the construction of multi-view robot data. It can also fabricate plausible but incorrect views of real events. Source-video and geometric conditioning constrain generation but do not guarantee factual fidelity, especially in disoccluded regions. Track validity is an observation-support signal, not a forensic test. Deployment should distinguish generated views from recorded footage and respect the base model’s license and safety requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 可控的新视角视频合成能够支持内容创作、沉浸式媒体、仿真以及多视角机器人数据的构建。 它也可能伪造出看似合理但不正确的真实事件视角。 源视频与几何条件约束可以限制生成过程，但无法保证事实的忠实性，尤其是在被遮挡区域重新可见的部分。 轨迹有效性是一种观察支持信号，而非取证测试。 部署时应将生成视角与录制素材区分开来，并遵守基础模型的许可与安全要求。

sents.en: Controllable novel-view video synthesis can support content creation, immersive media, simulation, and the construction of multi-view robot data.
sents.zh: 可控的新视角视频合成能够支持内容创作、沉浸式媒体、仿真以及多视角机器人数据的构建。

sents.en: It can also fabricate plausible but incorrect views of real events.
sents.zh: 它也可能伪造出看似合理但不正确的真实事件视角。

sents.en: Source-video and geometric conditioning constrain generation but do not guarantee factual fidelity, especially in disoccluded regions.

sents.zh: 轨迹有效性是一种观察支持信号，而非取证测试。

sents.en: Deployment should distinguish generated views from recorded footage and respect the base model’s license and safety requirements.
sents.zh: 部署时应将生成视角与录制素材区分开来，并遵守基础模型的许可与安全要求。

paragraphs.en: We will release the code, pretrained models, the predictions of all evaluated methods, and the evaluation code at https://github.com/NIRVANALAN/Holo4D . External assets retain their original licenses and terms. Table 26 lists the licenses stated by their official repositories and release cards, distinguishing code, data, and model weights. Third-party footage and component assets retain their own terms. Training datasets and baseline backbones are listed in Tables 9 and 10 . Camera-adherence evaluation uses DAVIS [ 80 ] ; real novel-view evaluation uses iPhone/DyCheck [ 81 ] . Pretrained components include the Wan 2.1 backbone [ 70 ] , the umT5-XXL text encoder [ 93 ] , DepthAnything 3 [ 4 ] , and 4RC [ 6 ] . Reconstruction and preprocessing also use VGGT- Ω \Omega [ 5 ] , CoWTracker [ 18 ] , GMOS [ 83 ] , V-DPM [ 8 ] , and Open-D4RT [ 7 ] . Evaluation uses Pi3 [ 28 ] , VBench [ 84 ] , held-out Syn4D scenes, and Vista4D’s released trajectory benchmark [ 11 ] . The 5B models use Wan2.2-TI2V-5B, the long-video continuation model uses Wan2.1-I2V-14B, and both additionally train on OmniWorld-DROID [ 92 , 85 ] . Robot reshooting uses DROID [ 85 ] and publicly available online videos of Figure and Tesla Optimus humanoid robots, shown for qualitative illustration only; policy experiments use Fast-WAM [ 65 ] , LIBERO [ 86 ] , and LIBERO-plus [ 87 ] . SAM3 [ 94 ] supplies precomputed MultiCamVideo foreground masks.

paragraphs.en: Question: Do the main claims made in the abstract and introduction accurately reflect the paper’s contributions and scope?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：摘要和引言中提出的主要观点是否准确反映了论文的贡献和范围？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The abstract and the contribution list at the end of Section 1 claim a holistic scaffold of persistent 3D trajectories that carry source appearance, channel-wise conditioning of a pretrained video diffusion model on these trajectories, and evaluations against reshooting baselines, reconstructor substitutions, trajectory perturbations, and robot videos. These claims are supported by Tables 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 and 6 and Section 4.5 ; the policy-learning result is reported as mixed ( Table 7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 依据：摘要与第1节末尾的贡献列表声称提出了一个整体性框架，用于生成携带源外观的持久3D轨迹、让预训练视频扩散模型在这些轨迹上进行通道级条件控制，并针对重拍基线、重建器替换、轨迹扰动以及机器人视频进行了评估。 这些主张由表1、2、3、4、5和6以及第4.5节支持；策略学习的结果被报告为好坏参半（表7）。

sents.en: Justification: The abstract and the contribution list at the end of Section 1 claim a holistic scaffold of persistent 3D trajectories that carry source appearance, channel-wise conditioning of a pretrained video diffusion model on these trajectories, and evaluations against reshooting baselines, reconstructor substitutions, trajectory perturbations, and robot videos.
sents.zh: 依据：摘要与第1节末尾的贡献列表声称提出了一个整体性框架，用于生成携带源外观的持久3D轨迹、让预训练视频扩散模型在这些轨迹上进行通道级条件控制，并针对重拍基线、重建器替换、轨迹扰动以及机器人视频进行了评估。

sents.en: These claims are supported by Tables 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 and 6 and Section 4.5 ; the policy-learning result is reported as mixed ( Table 7 ).
sents.zh: 这些主张由表1、2、3、4、5和6以及第4.5节支持；策略学习的结果被报告为好坏参半（表7）。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the abstract and introduction do not include the claims made in the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示摘要和引言中不包含论文中所做的声明。

paragraphs.en: The abstract and/or introduction should clearly state the claims made, including the contributions made in the paper and important assumptions and limitations. A [No] or [N/A] answer to this question will not be perceived well by the reviewers.
paragraphs.zh: 摘要和/或引言应清楚地陈述所提出的主张，包括论文所作的贡献以及重要的假设和局限性。 对此问题回答[否]或[不适用]将不会给审稿人留下好印象。

sents.en: The abstract and/or introduction should clearly state the claims made, including the contributions made in the paper and important assumptions and limitations.
sents.zh: 摘要和/或引言应清楚地陈述所提出的主张，包括论文所作的贡献以及重要的假设和局限性。

sents.en: A [No] or [N/A] answer to this question will not be perceived well by the reviewers.
sents.zh: 对此问题回答[否]或[不适用]将不会给审稿人留下好印象。

paragraphs.en: The claims made should match theoretical and experimental results, and reflect how much the results can be expected to generalize to other settings.
paragraphs.zh: 所提出的声明应当与理论和实验结果相匹配，并反映这些结果在多大程度上可以预期推广到其他场景。

paragraphs.en: It is fine to include aspirational goals as motivation as long as it is clear that these goals are not attained by the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 可以包含愿景性目标作为动机，但前提是必须清楚地表明这些目标并未在论文中实现。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper discuss the limitations of the work performed by the authors?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否讨论了作者所完成工作的局限性？

paragraphs.en: Justification: Section 5 states that Holo4D remains sensitive to geometric error, incomplete source coverage, and difficult camera trajectories. Tables 5 and 21 quantify the sensitivity to trajectory noise; Appendix K describes remaining failure modes (fine dynamic structures, large disoccluded regions) and missing coverage for content that enters after the query frame ( Figure 19 ); Section 4.5 states that the long-video continuation model is not zero-shot and that the policy-learning results are mixed and single-seed.
paragraphs.zh: 依据说明：第 5 节指出 Holo4D 仍然对几何误差、不完整的源覆盖以及困难的相机轨迹较为敏感。 表 5 和表 21 量化了对轨迹噪声的敏感性；附录 K 描述了剩余的失败模式（精细的动态结构、大面积去遮挡区域）以及对在查询帧之后才出现的内容缺少覆盖（图 19）；第 4.5 节指出长视频续写模型并非零样本，且策略学习的结果参差不齐且仅使用单一随机种子。

sents.en: Justification: Section 5 states that Holo4D remains sensitive to geometric error, incomplete source coverage, and difficult camera trajectories.
sents.zh: 依据说明：第 5 节指出 Holo4D 仍然对几何误差、不完整的源覆盖以及困难的相机轨迹较为敏感。

sents.en: Tables 5 and 21 quantify the sensitivity to trajectory noise; Appendix K describes remaining failure modes (fine dynamic structures, large disoccluded regions) and missing coverage for content that enters after the query frame ( Figure 19 ); Section 4.5 states that the long-video continuation model is not zero-shot and that the policy-learning results are mixed and single-seed.
sents.zh: 表 5 和表 21 量化了对轨迹噪声的敏感性；附录 K 描述了剩余的失败模式（精细的动态结构、大面积去遮挡区域）以及对在查询帧之后才出现的内容缺少覆盖（图 19）；第 4.5 节指出长视频续写模型并非零样本，且策略学习的结果参差不齐且仅使用单一随机种子。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper has no limitation while the answer [No] means that the paper has limitations, but those are not discussed in the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 回答 [N/A] 表示该论文没有局限性，而回答 [No] 表示该论文存在局限性，但论文中未对其进行讨论。

paragraphs.en: The authors are encouraged to create a separate “Limitations” section in their paper.
paragraphs.zh: 建议作者在论文中单独创建一个「局限性」部分。

paragraphs.en: The paper should point out any strong assumptions and how robust the results are to violations of these assumptions (e.g., independence assumptions, noiseless settings, model well-specification, asymptotic approximations only holding locally). The authors should reflect on how these assumptions might be violated in practice and what the implications would be.
paragraphs.zh: 论文应指出任何较强的假设，以及当这些假设被违反时结果的稳健性如何（例如，独立性假设、无噪声设定、模型设定良好、仅在局部成立的渐近近似）。 作者应思考这些假设在实践中可能如何被违反，以及由此带来的影响是什么。

sents.en: The paper should point out any strong assumptions and how robust the results are to violations of these assumptions (e.g., independence assumptions, noiseless settings, model well-specification, asymptotic approximations only holding locally).
sents.zh: 论文应指出任何较强的假设，以及当这些假设被违反时结果的稳健性如何（例如，独立性假设、无噪声设定、模型设定良好、仅在局部成立的渐近近似）。

sents.en: The authors should reflect on how these assumptions might be violated in practice and what the implications would be.
sents.zh: 作者应思考这些假设在实践中可能如何被违反，以及由此带来的影响是什么。

paragraphs.en: The authors should reflect on the scope of the claims made, e.g., if the approach was only tested on a few datasets or with a few runs. In general, empirical results often depend on implicit assumptions, which should be articulated.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应当反思其所做主张的范围，例如，如果该方法仅在少量数据集上测试或仅运行了少数几次。 总体而言，实证结果往往依赖于隐含的假设，这些假设应当被明确说明。

sents.en: The authors should reflect on the scope of the claims made, e.g., if the approach was only tested on a few datasets or with a few runs.
sents.zh: 作者应当反思其所做主张的范围，例如，如果该方法仅在少量数据集上测试或仅运行了少数几次。

sents.en: In general, empirical results often depend on implicit assumptions, which should be articulated.
sents.zh: 总体而言，实证结果往往依赖于隐含的假设，这些假设应当被明确说明。

paragraphs.en: The authors should reflect on the factors that influence the performance of the approach. For example, a facial recognition algorithm may perform poorly when image resolution is low or images are taken in low lighting. Or a speech-to-text system might not be used reliably to provide closed captions for online lectures because it fails to handle technical jargon.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应当反思影响该方法性能的因素。 例如，人脸识别算法在图像分辨率较低或图像拍摄于弱光环境下时，性能可能较差。 又或者，语音转文字系统可能无法可靠地用于为在线讲座提供隐藏式字幕，因为它无法处理专业术语。

sents.en: The authors should reflect on the factors that influence the performance of the approach.
sents.zh: 作者应当反思影响该方法性能的因素。

sents.en: For example, a facial recognition algorithm may perform poorly when image resolution is low or images are taken in low lighting.
sents.zh: 例如，人脸识别算法在图像分辨率较低或图像拍摄于弱光环境下时，性能可能较差。

sents.en: Or a speech-to-text system might not be used reliably to provide closed captions for online lectures because it fails to handle technical jargon.
sents.zh: 又或者，语音转文字系统可能无法可靠地用于为在线讲座提供隐藏式字幕，因为它无法处理专业术语。

paragraphs.en: The authors should discuss the computational efficiency of the proposed algorithms and how they scale with dataset size.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应讨论所提出算法的计算效率，以及它们如何随数据集规模扩展。

paragraphs.en: If applicable, the authors should discuss possible limitations of their approach to address problems of privacy and fairness.
paragraphs.zh: 如适用，作者应讨论其方法在解决隐私和公平性问题方面可能存在的局限性。

paragraphs.en: While the authors might fear that complete honesty about limitations might be used by reviewers as grounds for rejection, a worse outcome might be that reviewers discover limitations that aren’t acknowledged in the paper. The authors should use their best judgment and recognize that individual actions in favor of transparency play an important role in developing norms that preserve the integrity of the community. Reviewers will be specifically instructed to not penalize honesty concerning limitations.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然作者可能担心对局限性完全坦诚会被审稿人用作拒绝的理由，但更糟糕的结果可能是审稿人发现了论文中未曾承认的局限性。 作者应运用自己最好的判断，并认识到支持透明度的个人行为在制定维护学术共同体诚信的规范方面发挥着重要作用。 审稿人将受到明确指示，不得因对局限性的坦诚而进行惩罚。

sents.en: While the authors might fear that complete honesty about limitations might be used by reviewers as grounds for rejection, a worse outcome might be that reviewers discover limitations that aren’t acknowledged in the paper.
sents.zh: 虽然作者可能担心对局限性完全坦诚会被审稿人用作拒绝的理由，但更糟糕的结果可能是审稿人发现了论文中未曾承认的局限性。

sents.en: The authors should use their best judgment and recognize that individual actions in favor of transparency play an important role in developing norms that preserve the integrity of the community.
sents.zh: 作者应运用自己最好的判断，并认识到支持透明度的个人行为在制定维护学术共同体诚信的规范方面发挥着重要作用。

sents.en: Reviewers will be specifically instructed to not penalize honesty concerning limitations.
sents.zh: 审稿人将受到明确指示，不得因对局限性的坦诚而进行惩罚。

paragraphs.en: Question: For each theoretical result, does the paper provide the full set of assumptions and a complete (and correct) proof?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：对于每项理论结果，论文是否提供了完整的假设集合以及完整（且正确）的证明？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The paper presents an empirical method and does not introduce formal theorems or proofs.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：本文提出的是一种实证方法，未引入形式化的定理或证明。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not include theoretical results.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文不包含理论结果。

paragraphs.en: All the theorems, formulas, and proofs in the paper should be numbered and cross-referenced.
paragraphs.zh: 论文中的所有定理、公式和证明都应编号并进行交叉引用。

paragraphs.en: All assumptions should be clearly stated or referenced in the statement of any theorems.
paragraphs.zh: 所有假设都应在任何定理的陈述中被清晰地说明或引用。

paragraphs.en: The proofs can either appear in the main paper or the supplemental material, but if they appear in the supplemental material, the authors are encouraged to provide a short proof sketch to provide intuition.
paragraphs.zh: 证明可以出现在正文或补充材料中，但如果出现在补充材料中，鼓励作者提供简短的证明概要以提供直观理解。

paragraphs.en: Inversely, any informal proof provided in the core of the paper should be complemented by formal proofs provided in appendix or supplemental material.
paragraphs.zh: 反之，论文正文中提供的任何非正式证明，都应当由附录或补充材料中提供的正式证明加以补充。

paragraphs.en: Theorems and Lemmas that the proof relies upon should be properly referenced.
paragraphs.zh: 证明所依赖的定理与引理应当被恰当地引用。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper fully disclose all the information needed to reproduce the main experimental results of the paper to the extent that it affects the main claims and/or conclusions of the paper (regardless of whether the code and data are provided or not)?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否充分披露了复现论文主要实验结果所需的全部信息，以致于影响论文的主要论断和/或结论（无论是否提供了代码和数据）？

paragraphs.en: Justification: Section 3 defines the trajectory scaffold, its projection and encoding, and the channel-wise conditioning of the generator; Section 3.4 gives the backbone, training schedule, learning rates, and batch sizes; Appendices B and C give module dimensions, augmentation, long-video inference, dataset weights, and annotation sources; Appendices D , E , F and I give the evaluation sets, trajectories, and camera-recovery protocols.
paragraphs.zh: 理由说明：第 3 节定义了轨迹支架（trajectory scaffold）、其投影与编码，以及生成器的逐通道条件控制；第 3.4 节给出了骨干网络、训练日程、学习率和批量大小；附录 B 和 C 给出了模块维度、数据增强、长视频推理、数据集权重和标注来源；附录 D、E、F 和 I 给出了评估集、轨迹和相机恢复协议。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not include experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文不包含实验。

paragraphs.en: If the paper includes experiments, a [No] answer to this question will not be perceived well by the reviewers: Making the paper reproducible is important, regardless of whether the code and data are provided or not.
paragraphs.zh: 如果论文包含实验，对这个问题回答 [No] 会让审稿人产生不好的印象：无论如何，让论文具有可复现性是很重要的，无论是否提供了代码和数据。

paragraphs.en: If the contribution is a dataset and/or model, the authors should describe the steps taken to make their results reproducible or verifiable.
paragraphs.zh: 如果贡献是数据集和/或模型，作者应描述其为使结果可复现或可验证所采取的步骤。

paragraphs.en: Depending on the contribution, reproducibility can be accomplished in various ways. For example, if the contribution is a novel architecture, describing the architecture fully might suffice, or if the contribution is a specific model and empirical evaluation, it may be necessary to either make it possible for others to replicate the model with the same dataset, or provide access to the model. In general. releasing code and data is often one good way to accomplish this, but reproducibility can also be provided via detailed instructions for how to replicate the results, access to a hosted model (e.g., in the case of a large language model), releasing of a model checkpoint, or other means that are appropriate to the research performed.
paragraphs.zh: 根据贡献内容的不同，可复现性可以通过多种方式实现。 例如，如果贡献是一种新架构，那么完整描述该架构可能就足够了；而如果贡献是一个具体模型及其实证评估，则可能有必要让其他人能够用相同的数据集复现该模型，或者提供对该模型的访问。 一般来说，发布代码和数据通常是实现这一目标的好方法之一，但可复现性也可以通过详细的复现结果说明、提供托管模型的访问（例如大型语言模型的情况）、发布模型检查点，或其他适合所做研究的方式来提供。

sents.en: Depending on the contribution, reproducibility can be accomplished in various ways.
sents.zh: 根据贡献内容的不同，可复现性可以通过多种方式实现。

sents.en: For example, if the contribution is a novel architecture, describing the architecture fully might suffice, or if the contribution is a specific model and empirical evaluation, it may be necessary to either make it possible for others to replicate the model with the same dataset, or provide access to the model.
sents.zh: 例如，如果贡献是一种新架构，那么完整描述该架构可能就足够了；而如果贡献是一个具体模型及其实证评估，则可能有必要让其他人能够用相同的数据集复现该模型，或者提供对该模型的访问。

sents.en: In general. releasing code and data is often one good way to accomplish this, but reproducibility can also be provided via detailed instructions for how to replicate the results, access to a hosted model (e.g., in the case of a large language model), releasing of a model checkpoint, or other means that are appropriate to the research performed.
sents.zh: 一般来说，发布代码和数据通常是实现这一目标的好方法之一，但可复现性也可以通过详细的复现结果说明、提供托管模型的访问（例如大型语言模型的情况）、发布模型检查点，或其他适合所做研究的方式来提供。

paragraphs.en: While NeurIPS does not require releasing code, the conference does require all submissions to provide some reasonable avenue for reproducibility, which may depend on the nature of the contribution. For example
paragraphs.zh: 虽然 NeurIPS 不要求发布代码，但会议确实要求所有投稿提供某种合理的可复现性途径，这可能取决于贡献的性质。例如

paragraphs.en: If the contribution is primarily a new algorithm, the paper should make it clear how to reproduce that algorithm.
paragraphs.zh: 如果贡献主要是一种新算法，论文应清楚地说明如何复现该算法。

paragraphs.en: If the contribution is primarily a new model architecture, the paper should describe the architecture clearly and fully.
paragraphs.zh: 如果贡献主要是一种新的模型架构，论文应当清晰、完整地描述该架构。

paragraphs.en: If the contribution is a new model (e.g., a large language model), then there should either be a way to access this model for reproducing the results or a way to reproduce the model (e.g., with an open-source dataset or instructions for how to construct the dataset).
paragraphs.zh: 如果贡献是新的模型（例如，一个大语言模型），那么应当提供获取该模型以复现结果的方式，或提供复现该模型的方式（例如，使用开源数据集或构建数据集的说明）。

paragraphs.en: We recognize that reproducibility may be tricky in some cases, in which case authors are welcome to describe the particular way they provide for reproducibility. In the case of closed-source models, it may be that access to the model is limited in some way (e.g., to registered users), but it should be possible for other researchers to have some path to reproducing or verifying the results.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认识到，在某些情况下可复现性可能比较棘手，在这种情况下，欢迎作者描述他们为保障可复现性所采取的特定方式。 对于闭源模型，对模型的访问可能在某些方面受到限制（例如仅限注册用户），但其他研究人员仍应有可能通过某种途径来复现或验证结果。

sents.en: We recognize that reproducibility may be tricky in some cases, in which case authors are welcome to describe the particular way they provide for reproducibility.
sents.zh: 我们认识到，在某些情况下可复现性可能比较棘手，在这种情况下，欢迎作者描述他们为保障可复现性所采取的特定方式。

sents.en: In the case of closed-source models, it may be that access to the model is limited in some way (e.g., to registered users), but it should be possible for other researchers to have some path to reproducing or verifying the results.
sents.zh: 对于闭源模型，对模型的访问可能在某些方面受到限制（例如仅限注册用户），但其他研究人员仍应有可能通过某种途径来复现或验证结果。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper provide open access to the data and code, with sufficient instructions to faithfully reproduce the main experimental results, as described in supplemental material?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否按照补充材料中的描述，为数据和代码提供开放访问，并附有足以忠实复现主要实验结果的说明？

paragraphs.en: Justification: We will publicly release the code, pretrained models, the predictions of all evaluated methods, and the evaluation code, with instructions to reproduce the main results, at https://github.com/NIRVANALAN/Holo4D ( Appendix N ). All training datasets ( Table 9 ) and evaluation benchmarks are publicly available, and the data sources and evaluation protocols are described in Appendices C , D , E , F and I .
paragraphs.zh: 论证：我们将在 https://github.com/NIRVANALAN/Holo4D 公开发布代码、预训练模型、所有被评估方法的预测结果以及评估代码，并附带复现主要结果的说明（附录 N）。 所有训练数据集（表 9）和评估基准均已公开可用，数据来源和评估协议在附录 C、D、E、F 和 I 中进行了说明。

sents.en: Justification: We will publicly release the code, pretrained models, the predictions of all evaluated methods, and the evaluation code, with instructions to reproduce the main results, at https://github.com/NIRVANALAN/Holo4D ( Appendix N ).
sents.zh: 论证：我们将在 https://github.com/NIRVANALAN/Holo4D 公开发布代码、预训练模型、所有被评估方法的预测结果以及评估代码，并附带复现主要结果的说明（附录 N）。

sents.en: All training datasets ( Table 9 ) and evaluation benchmarks are publicly available, and the data sources and evaluation protocols are described in Appendices C , D , E , F and I .
sents.zh: 所有训练数据集（表 9）和评估基准均已公开可用，数据来源和评估协议在附录 C、D、E、F 和 I 中进行了说明。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that paper does not include experiments requiring code.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文不包含需要代码的实验。

paragraphs.en: Please see the NeurIPS code and data submission guidelines ( https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy ) for more details.
paragraphs.zh: 请参阅 NeurIPS 代码和数据提交指南（ https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy ）了解更多详情。

paragraphs.en: While we encourage the release of code and data, we understand that this might not be possible, so [No] is an acceptable answer. Papers cannot be rejected simply for not including code, unless this is central to the contribution (e.g., for a new open-source benchmark).
paragraphs.zh: 虽然我们鼓励发布代码和数据，但我们理解这有时可能无法做到，因此回答「否」是可以接受的。 论文不能仅仅因为没有包含代码而被拒稿，除非代码是该贡献的核心（例如，对于一个新的开源基准测试）。

sents.en: While we encourage the release of code and data, we understand that this might not be possible, so [No] is an acceptable answer.
sents.zh: 虽然我们鼓励发布代码和数据，但我们理解这有时可能无法做到，因此回答「否」是可以接受的。

sents.en: Papers cannot be rejected simply for not including code, unless this is central to the contribution (e.g., for a new open-source benchmark).
sents.zh: 论文不能仅仅因为没有包含代码而被拒稿，除非代码是该贡献的核心（例如，对于一个新的开源基准测试）。

paragraphs.en: The instructions should contain the exact command and environment needed to run to reproduce the results. See the NeurIPS code and data submission guidelines ( https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy ) for more details.
paragraphs.zh: 说明中应包含复现结果所需运行的确切命令和环境。 更多细节请参阅 NeurIPS 代码与数据提交指南（ https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy ）。

sents.en: The instructions should contain the exact command and environment needed to run to reproduce the results.
sents.zh: 说明中应包含复现结果所需运行的确切命令和环境。

sents.en: See the NeurIPS code and data submission guidelines ( https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy ) for more details.
sents.zh: 更多细节请参阅 NeurIPS 代码与数据提交指南（ https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy ）。

paragraphs.en: The authors should provide instructions on data access and preparation, including how to access the raw data, preprocessed data, intermediate data, and generated data, etc.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应提供关于数据访问与准备的说明，包括如何访问原始数据、预处理数据、中间数据和生成数据等。

paragraphs.en: The authors should provide scripts to reproduce all experimental results for the new proposed method and baselines. If only a subset of experiments are reproducible, they should state which ones are omitted from the script and why.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应提供脚本，以复现新提出的方法和基线的所有实验结果。 如果只有部分实验可以复现，作者应说明哪些实验未包含在脚本中以及原因。

sents.en: The authors should provide scripts to reproduce all experimental results for the new proposed method and baselines.
sents.zh: 作者应提供脚本，以复现新提出的方法和基线的所有实验结果。

sents.en: If only a subset of experiments are reproducible, they should state which ones are omitted from the script and why.
sents.zh: 如果只有部分实验可以复现，作者应说明哪些实验未包含在脚本中以及原因。

paragraphs.en: At submission time, to preserve anonymity, the authors should release anonymized versions (if applicable).
paragraphs.zh: 提交时，为保持匿名，作者应发布匿名版本（如适用）。

paragraphs.en: Providing as much information as possible in supplemental material (appended to the paper) is recommended, but including URLs to data and code is permitted.
paragraphs.zh: 建议在补充材料（附于论文之后）中提供尽可能多的信息，但允许包含数据和代码的 URL 链接。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper specify all the training and test details (e.g., data splits, hyperparameters, how they were chosen, type of optimizer) necessary to understand the results?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否指定了理解结果所需的全部训练和测试细节（例如：数据划分、超参数、超参数的选择方式、优化器类型）？

paragraphs.en: Justification: Section 4 describes baselines, evaluation sets, reconstruction backends, and inference settings; Sections 3.4 , B and C give the optimizer (AdamW), learning rates, batch sizes, schedules, resolutions, data mixture, and augmentation; per-benchmark protocols are in Appendices D , E , F and I .
paragraphs.zh: 理由：第 4 节描述了基线、评测集、重建后端和推理设置；第 3.4 节、附录 B 和 C 给出了优化器（AdamW）、学习率、批量大小、调度策略、分辨率、数据混合和增强方法；各基准的评测协议见附录 D、E、F 和 I。

paragraphs.en: The experimental setting should be presented in the core of the paper to a level of detail that is necessary to appreciate the results and make sense of them.
paragraphs.zh: 实验设置应在论文核心部分以必要的详细程度呈现，以便读者理解结果并领会其意义。

paragraphs.en: The full details can be provided either with the code, in appendix, or as supplemental material.
paragraphs.zh: 完整细节可以通过代码、附录或补充材料提供。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper report error bars suitably and correctly defined or other appropriate information about the statistical significance of the experiments?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否恰当地报告了误差棒并给出正确定义，或提供了关于实验统计显著性的其他适当信息？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The main video-generation comparisons report point estimates, without repeated-training confidence intervals. Evaluation uses fixed benchmark pairs; valid camera-metric counts can differ by method ( Appendix E ). The early 1.3B conditioning study reports a confidence interval over pairs, runtime profiling reports variation across videos ( Table 22 ), and policy learning uses a single seed ( Appendix L ). These do not quantify uncertainty for the main results.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：主要的视频生成对比仅报告点估计，没有通过重复训练得到的置信区间。 评估使用固定的基准配对；有效的相机度量计数可能因方法而异（附录 E）。 早期的 1.3B 条件研究报告了配对上的置信区间，运行时分析报告了跨视频的波动（表 22），而策略学习仅使用单个随机种子（附录 L）。 这些并不能为主结果量化不确定性。

sents.en: Justification: The main video-generation comparisons report point estimates, without repeated-training confidence intervals.
sents.zh: 理由：主要的视频生成对比仅报告点估计，没有通过重复训练得到的置信区间。

sents.en: Evaluation uses fixed benchmark pairs; valid camera-metric counts can differ by method ( Appendix E ).
sents.zh: 评估使用固定的基准配对；有效的相机度量计数可能因方法而异（附录 E）。

sents.en: The early 1.3B conditioning study reports a confidence interval over pairs, runtime profiling reports variation across videos ( Table 22 ), and policy learning uses a single seed ( Appendix L ).
sents.zh: 早期的 1.3B 条件研究报告了配对上的置信区间，运行时分析报告了跨视频的波动（表 22），而策略学习仅使用单个随机种子（附录 L）。

sents.en: These do not quantify uncertainty for the main results.
sents.zh: 这些并不能为主结果量化不确定性。

paragraphs.en: The authors should answer [Yes] if the results are accompanied by error bars, confidence intervals, or statistical significance tests, at least for the experiments that support the main claims of the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 如果结果附有误差条、置信区间或统计显著性检验，作者应回答 [Yes]，至少对于支持论文主要论点的实验应如此。

paragraphs.en: The factors of variability that the error bars are capturing should be clearly stated (for example, train/test split, initialization, random drawing of some parameter, or overall run with given experimental conditions).
paragraphs.zh: 误差棒所捕捉的变异因素应予以明确说明（例如，训练/测试集划分、初始化、某些参数的随机抽取，或在给定实验条件下的整体运行）。

paragraphs.en: The method for calculating the error bars should be explained (closed form formula, call to a library function, bootstrap, etc.)
paragraphs.zh: 误差棒的计算方法应予以说明（闭式公式、调用库函数、自助法等）。

paragraphs.en: The assumptions made should be given (e.g., Normally distributed errors).
paragraphs.zh: 所做出的假设应当予以说明（例如，误差服从正态分布）。

paragraphs.en: It should be clear whether the error bar is the standard deviation or the standard error of the mean.
paragraphs.zh: 应当明确误差线表示的是标准差还是平均值的标准误。

paragraphs.en: It is OK to report 1-sigma error bars, but one should state it. The authors should preferably report a 2-sigma error bar than state that they have a 96% CI, if the hypothesis of Normality of errors is not verified.
paragraphs.zh: 可以报告1-sigma误差条，但应当予以说明。 如果误差的正态性假设未得到验证，作者最好报告2-sigma误差条，而不是声称他们拥有96%置信区间。

sents.en: It is OK to report 1-sigma error bars, but one should state it.
sents.zh: 可以报告1-sigma误差条，但应当予以说明。

sents.en: The authors should preferably report a 2-sigma error bar than state that they have a 96% CI, if the hypothesis of Normality of errors is not verified.
sents.zh: 如果误差的正态性假设未得到验证，作者最好报告2-sigma误差条，而不是声称他们拥有96%置信区间。

paragraphs.en: For asymmetric distributions, the authors should be careful not to show in tables or figures symmetric error bars that would yield results that are out of range (e.g., negative error rates).
paragraphs.zh: 对于非对称分布，作者应注意不要在表格或图表中展示会导致结果超出范围（例如，负的错误率）的对称误差条。

paragraphs.en: If error bars are reported in tables or plots, the authors should explain in the text how they were calculated and reference the corresponding figures or tables in the text.
paragraphs.zh: 如果误差棒以表格或图表形式呈现，作者应在正文中说明其计算方法，并在正文中引用相应的图或表。

paragraphs.en: Question: For each experiment, does the paper provide sufficient information on the computer resources (type of compute workers, memory, time of execution) needed to reproduce the experiments?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：对于每个实验，论文是否提供了足够的信息说明复现实验所需的计算资源（计算工作节点的类型、内存、执行时间）？

paragraphs.en: Justification: Appendix B reports the training compute: both stages run on NVIDIA GH200 GPUs for about 24 24 hours each, with stage 2 on 32 32 GPUs using FSDP. Appendix J reports inference hardware, time, and memory per stage and per reconstruction backend ( Tables 22 , 24 and 24 ).
paragraphs.zh: 理由：附录 B 报告了训练算力：两个阶段均在 NVIDIA GH200 GPU 上各运行约 24 小时，其中阶段 2 使用 32 块 GPU 并采用 FSDP。 附录 J 报告了各阶段及各重建后端的推理硬件、时间和内存（表 22、表 24 和表 24）。

sents.en: Justification: Appendix B reports the training compute: both stages run on NVIDIA GH200 GPUs for about 24 24 hours each, with stage 2 on 32 32 GPUs using FSDP.
sents.zh: 理由：附录 B 报告了训练算力：两个阶段均在 NVIDIA GH200 GPU 上各运行约 24 小时，其中阶段 2 使用 32 块 GPU 并采用 FSDP。

sents.en: Appendix J reports inference hardware, time, and memory per stage and per reconstruction backend ( Tables 22 , 24 and 24 ).
sents.zh: 附录 J 报告了各阶段及各重建后端的推理硬件、时间和内存（表 22、表 24 和表 24）。

paragraphs.en: The paper should indicate the type of compute workers CPU or GPU, internal cluster, or cloud provider, including relevant memory and storage.
paragraphs.zh: 论文应说明计算工作节点的类型，即 CPU 或 GPU、内部集群还是云服务商，并包括相关的内存和存储信息。

paragraphs.en: The paper should provide the amount of compute required for each of the individual experimental runs as well as estimate the total compute.
paragraphs.zh: 论文应提供每次单独实验运行所需的计算量，并估算总计算量。

paragraphs.en: The paper should disclose whether the full research project required more compute than the experiments reported in the paper (e.g., preliminary or failed experiments that didn’t make it into the paper).
paragraphs.zh: 论文应披露完整研究项目是否需要比论文中报告的实验更多的算力（例如，未写入论文的初步实验或失败实验）。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the research conducted in the paper conform, in every respect, with the NeurIPS Code of Ethics https://neurips.cc/public/EthicsGuidelines ?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文中进行的研究是否在各方面都符合 NeurIPS 伦理准则 https://neurips.cc/public/EthicsGuidelines ？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The work uses publicly released datasets and models and publicly available robot videos under their original terms ( Appendix N ), involves no new human-subject data collection, and discusses misuse risks ( Appendix M ).
paragraphs.zh: 正当性说明：本工作使用了公开发布的数据集与模型，以及按其原始条款可公开获取的机器人视频（附录 N），不涉及任何新的人类受试者数据收集，并讨论了滥用风险（附录 M）。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the authors have not reviewed the NeurIPS Code of Ethics.
paragraphs.zh: 回答 [N/A] 表示作者尚未审阅 NeurIPS 伦理准则（NeurIPS Code of Ethics）。

paragraphs.en: If the authors answer [No] , they should explain the special circumstances that require a deviation from the Code of Ethics.
paragraphs.zh: 如果作者回答 [No]，则应说明需要偏离伦理准则的特殊情况。

paragraphs.en: The authors should make sure to preserve anonymity (e.g., if there is a special consideration due to laws or regulations in their jurisdiction).
paragraphs.zh: 作者应确保保持匿名性（例如，若其所在司法管辖区的法律或法规有特殊考量）。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper discuss both potential positive societal impacts and negative societal impacts of the work performed?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否讨论了所开展工作可能产生的社会正面影响和社会负面影响？

paragraphs.en: Justification: Appendix M discusses positive uses (content creation, immersive media, simulation, and robot data) and the risk that generated views are mistaken for recorded footage, together with mitigations.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：附录 M 讨论了正面用途（内容创作、沉浸式媒体、仿真以及机器人数据），以及生成画面被误认为实拍录像的风险，并给出了相应的缓解措施。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that there is no societal impact of the work performed.
paragraphs.zh: 回答 [N/A] 表示所进行的工作没有社会影响。

paragraphs.en: If the authors answer [N/A] or [No] , they should explain why their work has no societal impact or why the paper does not address societal impact.
paragraphs.zh: 如果作者回答 [N/A] 或 [No]，他们应当解释为什么其工作没有社会影响，或者为什么论文未涉及社会影响。

paragraphs.en: Examples of negative societal impacts include potential malicious or unintended uses (e.g., disinformation, generating fake profiles, surveillance), fairness considerations (e.g., deployment of technologies that could make decisions that unfairly impact specific groups), privacy considerations, and security considerations.
paragraphs.zh: 负面社会影响的例子包括潜在的恶意或非预期用途（例如，虚假信息、生成虚假个人资料、监控）、公平性考量（例如，部署可能做出对特定群体产生不公平影响的技术）、隐私考量，以及安全性考量。

paragraphs.en: The conference expects that many papers will be foundational research and not tied to particular applications, let alone deployments. However, if there is a direct path to any negative applications, the authors should point it out. For example, it is legitimate to point out that an improvement in the quality of generative models could be used to generate Deepfakes for disinformation. On the other hand, it is not needed to point out that a generic algorithm for optimizing neural networks could enable people to train models that generate Deepfakes faster.
paragraphs.zh: 会议期望许多论文将是基础性研究，并不与特定应用挂钩，更不用说部署了。 然而，如果存在通往任何负面应用的直接路径，作者应当指出这一点。 例如，指出生成式模型质量的提升可能被用于生成虚假信息用的深度伪造（Deepfakes），是合理的。 另一方面，不需要指出的是，一种用于优化神经网络的通用算法可能使人们能够更快地训练生成深度伪造的模型。

sents.en: The conference expects that many papers will be foundational research and not tied to particular applications, let alone deployments.
sents.zh: 会议期望许多论文将是基础性研究，并不与特定应用挂钩，更不用说部署了。

sents.en: However, if there is a direct path to any negative applications, the authors should point it out.
sents.zh: 然而，如果存在通往任何负面应用的直接路径，作者应当指出这一点。

sents.en: For example, it is legitimate to point out that an improvement in the quality of generative models could be used to generate Deepfakes for disinformation.
sents.zh: 例如，指出生成式模型质量的提升可能被用于生成虚假信息用的深度伪造（Deepfakes），是合理的。

sents.en: On the other hand, it is not needed to point out that a generic algorithm for optimizing neural networks could enable people to train models that generate Deepfakes faster.
sents.zh: 另一方面，不需要指出的是，一种用于优化神经网络的通用算法可能使人们能够更快地训练生成深度伪造的模型。

paragraphs.en: The authors should consider possible harms that could arise when the technology is being used as intended and functioning correctly, harms that could arise when the technology is being used as intended but gives incorrect results, and harms following from (intentional or unintentional) misuse of the technology.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应考虑该技术在使用时符合预期且正常运行时可能产生的危害，技术在使用时符合预期但给出错误结果时可能产生的危害，以及（有意或无意）滥用该技术所导致的危害。

paragraphs.en: If there are negative societal impacts, the authors could also discuss possible mitigation strategies (e.g., gated release of models, providing defenses in addition to attacks, mechanisms for monitoring misuse, mechanisms to monitor how a system learns from feedback over time, improving the efficiency and accessibility of ML).
paragraphs.zh: 如果存在负面的社会影响，作者还可以讨论可能的缓解策略（例如，模型的门控发布、在提供攻击的同时提供防御手段、用于监控滥用的机制、监控系统如何随时间从反馈中学习的机制、提高机器学习的效率和可及性）。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper describe safeguards that have been put in place for responsible release of data or models that have a high risk for misuse (e.g., pre-trained language models, image generators, or scraped datasets)?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否描述了为负责任地发布具有较高滥用风险的数据或模型（例如，预训练语言模型、图像生成器或抓取的数据集）而已采取的保障措施？

paragraphs.en: Justification: Holo4D fine-tunes a publicly released video diffusion model (Wan2.1) and conditions on a given source video; it does not introduce a new high-risk pretrained model or a scraped dataset. Released checkpoints will follow the base model’s license and usage terms, and Appendix M discusses the risk that generated views are mistaken for recorded footage.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：Holo4D 对一个公开发布的视频扩散模型（Wan2.1）进行微调，并以给定的源视频为条件；它没有引入新的高风险预训练模型，也没有引入抓取的数据集。 发布的检查点将遵循基础模型的许可证与使用条款，附录 M 讨论了生成的视图被误认为真实拍摄画面的风险。

sents.en: Justification: Holo4D fine-tunes a publicly released video diffusion model (Wan2.1) and conditions on a given source video; it does not introduce a new high-risk pretrained model or a scraped dataset.
sents.zh: 理由：Holo4D 对一个公开发布的视频扩散模型（Wan2.1）进行微调，并以给定的源视频为条件；它没有引入新的高风险预训练模型，也没有引入抓取的数据集。

sents.en: Released checkpoints will follow the base model’s license and usage terms, and Appendix M discusses the risk that generated views are mistaken for recorded footage.
sents.zh: 发布的检查点将遵循基础模型的许可证与使用条款，附录 M 讨论了生成的视图被误认为真实拍摄画面的风险。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper poses no such risks.
paragraphs.zh: 回答 [N/A] 表示该论文不存在此类风险。

paragraphs.en: Released models that have a high risk for misuse or dual-use should be released with necessary safeguards to allow for controlled use of the model, for example by requiring that users adhere to usage guidelines or restrictions to access the model or implementing safety filters.
paragraphs.zh: 具有较高滥用或双重用途风险的已发布模型，应在发布时附带必要的保障措施，以实现对模型的受控使用，例如要求用户遵守使用指南或访问限制，或实施安全过滤器。

paragraphs.en: Datasets that have been scraped from the Internet could pose safety risks. The authors should describe how they avoided releasing unsafe images.
paragraphs.zh: 从互联网上抓取的数据集可能带来安全风险。 作者应说明他们是如何避免发布不安全图像的。

sents.en: Datasets that have been scraped from the Internet could pose safety risks.
sents.zh: 从互联网上抓取的数据集可能带来安全风险。

sents.en: The authors should describe how they avoided releasing unsafe images.
sents.zh: 作者应说明他们是如何避免发布不安全图像的。

paragraphs.en: We recognize that providing effective safeguards is challenging, and many papers do not require this, but we encourage authors to take this into account and make a best faith effort.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认识到，提供有效的安全保障具有挑战性，而且许多论文并不要求这一点，但我们鼓励作者将此考虑在内，并尽最大努力去做。

paragraphs.en: Question: Are the creators or original owners of assets (e.g., code, data, models), used in the paper, properly credited and are the license and terms of use explicitly mentioned and properly respected?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文中使用的资产（如代码、数据、模型）的创建者或原始所有者是否得到了适当的署名，且许可证和使用条款是否被明确提及并得到妥善遵守？

paragraphs.en: Justification: Every dataset, pretrained model, reconstruction method, and benchmark is cited at first use; Appendices N and C list them and state that they are used under their original licenses and terms. The humanoid-robot clips are publicly available online videos shown for qualitative illustration only.
paragraphs.zh: 说明：每个数据集、预训练模型、重建方法和基准在首次使用时均已引用；附录 N 和 C 列出了它们，并说明它们是在其原始许可证和条款下使用的。 人形机器人的视频片段是公开的在线视频，仅用于定性说明。

sents.en: Justification: Every dataset, pretrained model, reconstruction method, and benchmark is cited at first use; Appendices N and C list them and state that they are used under their original licenses and terms.
sents.zh: 说明：每个数据集、预训练模型、重建方法和基准在首次使用时均已引用；附录 N 和 C 列出了它们，并说明它们是在其原始许可证和条款下使用的。

sents.en: The humanoid-robot clips are publicly available online videos shown for qualitative illustration only.
sents.zh: 人形机器人的视频片段是公开的在线视频，仅用于定性说明。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not use existing assets.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文未使用现有资产。

paragraphs.en: The authors should cite the original paper that produced the code package or dataset.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应当引用生成该代码包或数据集的原始论文。

paragraphs.en: The authors should state which version of the asset is used and, if possible, include a URL.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应说明所使用的资产版本，并尽可能提供 URL。

paragraphs.en: The name of the license (e.g., CC-BY 4.0) should be included for each asset.
paragraphs.zh: 每个资产都应注明许可证名称（例如 CC-BY 4.0）。

paragraphs.en: For scraped data from a particular source (e.g., website), the copyright and terms of service of that source should be provided.
paragraphs.zh: 对于从特定来源（例如网站）抓取的数据，应提供该来源的版权和服务条款。

paragraphs.en: If assets are released, the license, copyright information, and terms of use in the package should be provided. For popular datasets, paperswithcode.com/datasets has curated licenses for some datasets. Their licensing guide can help determine the license of a dataset.
paragraphs.zh: 如果发布了资产，则应提供软件包中的许可证、版权信息和使用条款。 对于流行的数据集，paperswithcode.com/datasets 已为部分数据集整理了许可证信息。 其许可指南可帮助确定数据集的许可证。

sents.en: If assets are released, the license, copyright information, and terms of use in the package should be provided.
sents.zh: 如果发布了资产，则应提供软件包中的许可证、版权信息和使用条款。

sents.en: For popular datasets, paperswithcode.com/datasets has curated licenses for some datasets.
sents.zh: 对于流行的数据集，paperswithcode.com/datasets 已为部分数据集整理了许可证信息。

sents.en: Their licensing guide can help determine the license of a dataset.
sents.zh: 其许可指南可帮助确定数据集的许可证。

paragraphs.en: For existing datasets that are re-packaged, both the original license and the license of the derived asset (if it has changed) should be provided.
paragraphs.zh: 对于重新打包的现有数据集，应同时提供原始许可证和衍生资产的许可证（如有变更）。

paragraphs.en: If this information is not available online, the authors are encouraged to reach out to the asset’s creators.
paragraphs.zh: 如果这些信息无法在线获取，鼓励作者联系该资产的创建者。

paragraphs.en: Question: Are new assets introduced in the paper well documented and is the documentation provided alongside the assets?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文中引入的新资产是否有完善的文档记录，并且文档是否随资产一同提供？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The code, checkpoints, predictions, and evaluation code will be publicly released at https://github.com/NIRVANALAN/Holo4D ( Appendix N ) with documentation of the environment, training and inference commands, and data layout, under the base model’s license.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：代码、检查点、预测结果和评估代码将在 https://github.com/NIRVANALAN/Holo4D （附录 N）公开发布，并附带环境文档、训练与推理命令以及数据布局，遵循基础模型的许可证。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not release new assets.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文未发布新资产。

paragraphs.en: Researchers should communicate the details of the dataset/code/model as part of their submissions via structured templates. This includes details about training, license, limitations, etc.
The paper should discuss whether and how consent was obtained from people whose asset is used.
At submission time, remember to anonymize your assets (if applicable). You can either create an anonymized URL or include an anonymized zip file.
Crowdsourcing and research with human subjects

Question: For crowdsourcing experiments and research with human subjects, does the paper include the full text of instructions given to participants and screenshots, if applicable, as well as details about compensation (if any)?
Justification: The work involves no crowdsourcing or newly recruited human participants. It uses existing datasets and publicly available robot videos ( Appendices C and N ).
The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not involve crowdsourcing nor research with human subjects.

Including this information in the supplemental material is fine, but if the main contribution of the paper involves human subjects, then as much detail as possible should be included in the main paper.
paragraphs.zh: 将此信息包含在补充材料中是可以的，但如果论文的主要贡献涉及人类受试者，则应在正文中尽可能详细地说明相关细节。

paragraphs.en: According to the NeurIPS Code of Ethics, workers involved in data collection, curation, or other labor should be paid at least the minimum wage in the country of the data collector.
paragraphs.zh: 根据 NeurIPS 伦理准则，参与数据收集、整理或其他劳动的工作者应获得不低于数据收集者所在国家最低工资标准的报酬。

paragraphs.en: Institutional review board (IRB) approvals or equivalent for research with human subjects
paragraphs.zh: 针对以人类为受试者的研究所需的机构审查委员会（IRB）批准或同等许可

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper describe potential risks incurred by study participants, whether such risks were disclosed to the subjects, and whether Institutional Review Board (IRB) approvals (or an equivalent approval/review based on the requirements of your country or institution) were obtained?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否描述了研究参与者可能承担的风险、此类风险是否已告知受试者，以及是否获得了机构审查委员会（IRB）的批准（或基于您所在国家或机构要求的同等批准/审查）？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The paper does not involve research with human subjects, so IRB approval is not applicable.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：本文不涉及以人类为对象的研究，因此不适用机构审查委员会（IRB）批准。

paragraphs.en: Depending on the country in which research is conducted, IRB approval (or equivalent) may be required for any human subjects research. If you obtained IRB approval, you should clearly state this in the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 根据开展研究所处的国家不同，任何涉及人类受试者的研究可能都需要获得IRB（机构审查委员会）批准（或同等批准）。 如果你获得了IRB批准，应在论文中明确说明这一点。

sents.en: Depending on the country in which research is conducted, IRB approval (or equivalent) may be required for any human subjects research.
sents.zh: 根据开展研究所处的国家不同，任何涉及人类受试者的研究可能都需要获得IRB（机构审查委员会）批准（或同等批准）。

sents.en: If you obtained IRB approval, you should clearly state this in the paper.
sents.zh: 如果你获得了IRB批准，应在论文中明确说明这一点。

paragraphs.en: We recognize that the procedures for this may vary significantly between institutions and locations, and we expect authors to adhere to the NeurIPS Code of Ethics and the guidelines for their institution.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认识到，相关程序可能因机构和地点的不同而有显著差异，我们期望作者遵守 NeurIPS 伦理准则及其所在机构的指导方针。

paragraphs.en: For initial submissions, do not include any information that would break anonymity (if applicable), such as the institution conducting the review.
paragraphs.zh: 对于初次投稿，请勿包含任何可能破坏匿名性（如适用）的信息，例如进行评审的机构。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper describe the usage of LLMs if it is an important, original, or non-standard component of the core methods in this research? Note that if the LLM is used only for writing, editing, or formatting purposes and does not impact the core methodology, scientific rigor, or originality of the research, declaration is not required.
paragraphs.zh: 问题：如果大语言模型（LLM）是本研究的核心方法中重要、原创或非标准的组成部分，论文是否描述了其使用情况？ 请注意，如果大语言模型仅用于写作、编辑或排版目的，且不影响研究的方法论核心、科学严谨性或原创性，则无需声明。

sents.en: Question: Does the paper describe the usage of LLMs if it is an important, original, or non-standard component of the core methods in this research?
sents.zh: 问题：如果大语言模型（LLM）是本研究的核心方法中重要、原创或非标准的组成部分，论文是否描述了其使用情况？

sents.en: Note that if the LLM is used only for writing, editing, or formatting purposes and does not impact the core methodology, scientific rigor, or originality of the research, declaration is not required.
sents.zh: 请注意，如果大语言模型仅用于写作、编辑或排版目的，且不影响研究的方法论核心、科学严谨性或原创性，则无需声明。

paragraphs.en: Justification: LLMs are not part of the core methodology of Holo4D . The text encoder used by the diffusion backbone (umT5-XXL) is a standard component inherited from the Wan 2.1 base model and serves only as a frozen text-conditioning module rather than as an original methodological contribution.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：大语言模型不属于 Holo4D 的核心方法论。 扩散主干所使用的文本编码器（umT5-XXL）是继承自 Wan 2.1 基础模型的标准组件，仅作为冻结的文本条件模块，而非原创的方法学贡献。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the core method development in this research does not involve LLMs as any important, original, or non-standard components.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示本研究的核心方法开发不涉及将大语言模型作为任何重要、原创或非标准的组件。

paragraphs.en: Please refer to our LLM policy in the NeurIPS handbook for what should or should not be described.
paragraphs.zh: 请参阅 NeurIPS 手册中的大语言模型（LLM）政策，了解哪些内容应当或不应当被描述。
